title: RoboWorM: Evaluating Movement Realism, Consistency and Acceleration Affects in Embodied Video World Models
title_zh: RoboWorM：评估具身视频世界模型中的运动真实性、一致性与加速影响

paragraphs.en: Video world models (VWMs) are rapidly emerging as scalable neural simulators for robotic manipulation. However, most benchmarks only evaluate them as open-world video generators, using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that lack strict 3D spatial and kinematic reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce RoboWorM , a comprehensive, deployment-aware benchmark that leverages known hardware priors such as robot kinematic trees and fixed camera configurations, to systematically examine structural and spatiotemporal fidelity. RoboWorM curates 1,605 real-world episodes across single-arm, bimanual, and humanoid morphologies, spanning both Markovian and long-horizon non-Markovian tasks under single- and multi-view setups. To explicitly measure physical consistency, we propose two deterministic, VLM-free metrics: KIVA for intra-view kinematic stability, and RIGIS for multi-view geometric consistency. By exploiting intrinsic robotic invariants, KIVA improves hallucination detection alignment with human annotations by 25.8% relative to the strongest frontier VLMs, while RIGIS achieves a 130% higher Spearman correlation with human preferences. Furthermore, since real-world deployment requires low inference latency, we utilize RoboWorM to conduct the first large-scale audit of the quality-efficiency trade-off. Evaluating 9 state-of-the-art acceleration techniques across 3 leading world models (over 29,000 generated rollouts), we demonstrate how these acceleration methods can retain superficial visual quality while silently compromising deployment-critical physical constraints. Using our metrics, we achieve 2.3 × \times maximum inference speed-up with minimal quality loss.
paragraphs.zh: 视频世界模型（VWMs）正迅速成为面向机器人操作的可扩展神经模拟器。 然而，大多数基准仅将其作为开放世界视频生成器进行评估，使用的是缺乏严格三维空间与运动学推理能力的视觉语言模型（VLMs）。 为弥合这一差距，我们提出 RoboWorM，这是一个全面的、面向部署的基准，它利用已知的硬件先验（如机器人运动学树和固定相机配置），系统地考察结构与时空保真度。 RoboWorM 整理了 1,605 条真实世界片段，涵盖单臂、双臂和人形形态，并在单视角和多视角设置下包含马尔可夫性与长时程非马尔可夫性任务。 为了显式地衡量物理一致性，我们提出两个确定性的、无需 VLM 的指标：用于视角内运动学稳定性的 KIVA，以及用于多视角几何一致性的 RIGIS。 通过利用机器人内在的不变量，KIVA 将幻觉检测与人类标注的一致性相比最强的前沿 VLMs 提升了 25.8%，而 RIGIS 与人类偏好的 Spearman 相关系数高出 130%。 此外，由于真实部署要求低推理延迟，我们利用 RoboWorM 首次对质量与效率的权衡进行了大规模审计。 通过在 3 个领先的世界模型上评估 9 种最先进的加速技术（生成超过 29,000 条 rollout），我们展示了这些加速方法如何在保持表面视觉质量的同时，悄然损害部署关键的物理约束。 借助我们的指标，我们在质量损失极小的情况下实现了最大 2.3 × \times 的推理加速。

paragraphs.en: Video world models (VWMs) have recently emerged as scalable neural simulators for robotic manipulation, mitigating physical data scarcity by generating synthetic trajectories, ranking policies, and enabling model-based planning ( Jang et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) . However, the prevailing evaluation paradigms treat these models merely as open-world video generators. General-purpose benchmarks evaluate perceptual quality and text alignment ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026a ) , while recent robotics-aligned benchmarks rely heavily on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to score task plausibility ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Nguyen et al., 2026d ) . While valuable for assessing high-level semantic alignment, VLM evaluators suffer from optimism bias, struggle with strict 3D geometric reasoning, and evaluate physical AI in a vacuum. A generated robot video is not just a moving picture; it represents a physical system in motion. In reality, a robot’s mechanical arms cannot arbitrarily change length, its gripper cannot float disconnected in mid-air, and multiple cameras viewing the same workspace must capture the exact same 3D layout.
paragraphs.zh: 视频世界模型（VWMs）近年来已成为机器人操作的可扩展神经模拟器，通过生成合成轨迹、对策略进行排序以及支持基于模型的规划，缓解了物理数据稀缺的问题（Jang et al., 2025; Gao et al., 2026; Guo et al., 2026）。 然而，目前主流的评估范式仅仅将这些模型视为开放世界的视频生成器。 通用基准评估感知质量和文本对齐（Liu et al., 2024; Huang et al., 2024; Li et al., 2026a），而近期面向机器人的基准则严重依赖视觉-语言模型（VLMs）来为任务合理性打分（Jiang et al., 2026; Li et al., 2026c; Yang et al., 2026b; Nguyen et al., 2026d）。 尽管 VLM 评估器在评估高层语义对齐方面很有价值，但它存在乐观偏差，难以进行严格的 3D 几何推理，并且是在真空中评估物理 AI。 生成的机器人视频不仅仅是一段动态画面；它代表了一个处于运动中的物理系统。 在现实中，机器人的机械臂不能任意改变长度，其夹爪不能在半空中悬空脱离，并且从不同视角观察同一工作空间的多个相机必须捕捉到完全相同的 3D 布局。

paragraphs.en: To bridge this gap, we propose shifting physical evaluation toward a complementary deployment-aware setting. In real applications, practitioners generating synthetic data already possess explicit prior knowledge of their setup, e.g., the robot’s specific kinematic structure, task instructions, and fixed camera configurations. While evaluating world models as generic video generators is useful for open-world assessment, it leaves these critical structural priors unused. By actively leveraging these priors, we can construct deterministic, physics-grounded measurements that better align with the requirements of real-world robotics. Further, deployment introduces another critical constraint: inference efficiency . The high generation latency of world models poses a severe throughput bottleneck, motivating acceleration techniques like caching, sparse attention, and token pruning ( Lyu et al., 2025 ; Bu et al., 2026 ; Xi et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026d ; Li et al., 2026b ; Nawaz et al., 2026 ) . Since acceleration compresses structural representations, it preserves superficial perceptual appearance while silently violating strict kinematic constraints. Evaluating this quality-efficiency trade-off is thus an essential, yet largely unexplored, dimension of practical robotic deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥合这一差距，我们提出将物理评估转向一种互补的、面向部署的设定。 在实际应用中，生成合成数据的从业者已经掌握了关于其设置的明确先验知识，例如机器人的特定运动学结构、任务指令以及固定的相机配置。 虽然将世界模型作为通用视频生成器进行评估对于开放世界评估很有用，但这使得这些关键的结构先验未被利用。 通过主动利用这些先验，我们可以构建确定性的、基于物理的度量，从而更好地契合真实世界机器人技术的要求。 此外，部署还引入了另一个关键约束：推理效率。 世界模型的高生成延迟会造成严重的吞吐量瓶颈，这促使人们采用诸如缓存、稀疏注意力和token剪枝等加速技术（Lyu et al., 2025；Bu et al., 2026；Xi et al., 2025；Yang et al., 2026a；Li et al., 2026d；Li et al., 2026b；Nawaz et al., 2026）。 由于加速会压缩结构化表示，它在保留表面感知外观的同时，会悄悄地违反严格的运动学约束。 因此，评估这种质量-效率权衡是实际机器人部署中一个至关重要却在很大程度上尚未被探索的维度。

paragraphs.en: We introduce RoboWorM , a comprehensive, deployment-aware benchmark for evaluating both the structural fidelity and computational efficiency of robotic video world models. RoboWorM spans 1,605 episodes curated from five source datasets, covering single-arm, bimanual, and complex humanoid morphologies across single- and multi-view setups as well as short- and long-horizontal tasks (Fig. 1 -a). To systematically localize physical failure modes, we propose two novel, VLM-free algorithmic evaluators . While prior works attempt to measure physical properties by asking generic VLM judges if a video “looks correct” ( Rong et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ; Yang et al., 2026b ) , a method fundamentally lacking in strict spatial reasoning, we instead leverage known deployment priors to construct deterministic, physics-grounded measurements (Fig. 1 -b).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 RoboWorM，这是一个全面且面向部署的基准，用于评估机器人视频世界模型的结构保真度与计算效率。 RoboWorM 涵盖从五个源数据集中精选的 1,605 个片段，覆盖单臂、双臂以及复杂的人形机器人形态，包含单视角与多视角设置，以及短时域与长时域任务（图 1-a）。 为了系统地定位物理失效模式，我们提出两种新颖的、不依赖 VLM 的算法评估器。 已有工作试图通过询问通用 VLM 裁判视频“看起来是否正确”来度量物理属性（Rong et al., 2026; Li et al., 2026c; Yang et al., 2026b），这种方法从根本上缺乏严格的空间推理能力；与之不同，我们利用已知的部署先验来构建确定性的、基于物理的度量方法（图 1-b）。

sents.en: We introduce RoboWorM , a comprehensive, deployment-aware benchmark for evaluating both the structural fidelity and computational efficiency of robotic video world models.

paragraphs.en: First, we audit intra-view physical hallucinations through KIVA , which maps robot joint actions to keypoints to evaluate kinematic violations and physical plausibility. Since hallucinated videos yield out-of-distribution visual tokens, these estimates violate kinematic invariants, explicitly exposing the errors. Second, we verify cross-view consistency through RIGIS , a Robotic Inter-view Geometry & Intrinsic-Extrinsic Stability framework, which ensures that synchronized views form a unified 3D scene with temporally stable camera extrinsics and intrinsics. Armed with these deterministic metrics, we utilize RoboWorM to conduct a comprehensive audit of the quality-efficiency trade-off in robotic video generation. In summary, our core contributions are:
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们通过 KIVA 审查视角内的物理幻觉，该方法将机器人关节动作映射到关键点上，以评估运动学违规与物理合理性。 由于产生幻觉的视频会生成分布外的视觉标记，这些估计会违反运动学不变量，从而显式地暴露错误。 其次，我们通过 RIGIS 验证跨视角一致性，RIGIS 是一个机器人视角间几何与内外参稳定性框架，确保同步的多个视角构成统一的三维场景，并具有时间上稳定的相机外参与内参。 借助这些确定性指标，我们利用 RoboWorM 对机器人视频生成中质量与效率的权衡进行全面审查。 总而言之，我们的核心贡献如下：

sents.en: First, we audit intra-view physical hallucinations through KIVA , which maps robot joint actions to keypoints to evaluate kinematic violations and physical plausibility.

paragraphs.en: A Diverse Benchmark for Robot World Models: We curate a rigorous evaluation suite of 1,605 episodes encompassing three major robot morphologies (single-arm, bimanual, humanoid). The benchmark spans both short Markovian interactions and long-horizon, non-Markovian tasks involving multiple subgoals and up to four synchronized camera views.
paragraphs.zh: 一个面向机器人世界模型的多样化基准：我们精心构建了一套严谨的评估套件，包含 1,605 个片段，涵盖三种主要机器人形态（单臂、双臂、人形）。 该基准既涵盖短时马尔可夫交互，也涵盖长时域、非马尔可夫任务，这些任务涉及多个子目标以及多达四个同步相机视角。

sents.en: A Diverse Benchmark for Robot World Models: We curate a rigorous evaluation suite of 1,605 episodes encompassing three major robot morphologies (single-arm, bimanual, humanoid).
sents.zh: 一个面向机器人世界模型的多样化基准：我们精心构建了一套严谨的评估套件，包含 1,605 个片段，涵盖三种主要机器人形态（单臂、双臂、人形）。

sents.en: The benchmark spans both short Markovian interactions and long-horizon, non-Markovian tasks involving multiple subgoals and up to four synchronized camera views.
sents.zh: 该基准既涵盖短时马尔可夫交互，也涵盖长时域、非马尔可夫任务，这些任务涉及多个子目标以及多达四个同步相机视角。

paragraphs.en: Deployment-Aware Physical Auditing: We introduce KIVA and RIGIS, two deterministic, physics-grounded metrics leveraging known embodiment and geometric priors to evaluate kinematic stability and multi-view consistency. These metrics directly contrast with, and systematically outperform, VLM-based evaluators in human-preference alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 部署感知的物理审计：我们提出 KIVA 与 RIGIS 两个确定性的、基于物理的指标，利用已知的具身形态与几何先验来评估运动学稳定性与多视角一致性。 这些指标与基于视觉语言模型的评估器形成直接对比，并在人类偏好对齐方面系统性地优于后者。

sents.en: Deployment-Aware Physical Auditing: We introduce KIVA and RIGIS, two deterministic, physics-grounded metrics leveraging known embodiment and geometric priors to evaluate kinematic stability and multi-view consistency.
sents.zh: 部署感知的物理审计：我们提出 KIVA 与 RIGIS 两个确定性的、基于物理的指标，利用已知的具身形态与几何先验来评估运动学稳定性与多视角一致性。

sents.en: These metrics directly contrast with, and systematically outperform, VLM-based evaluators in human-preference alignment.
sents.zh: 这些指标与基于视觉语言模型的评估器形成直接对比，并在人类偏好对齐方面系统性地优于后者。

paragraphs.en: Auditing Inference Acceleration at Scale: We systematically evaluate the quality-efficiency trade-off by auditing 9 state-of-the-art acceleration strategies (Fig. 1 -c), spanning token merging, feature caching, and sparse attention, integrated across three leading world models DreamGen ( Jang et al., 2025 ) , DreamDojo ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , and Ctrl-World ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . By assessing over 29,000 generated rollouts, we expose how computational shortcuts (yielding up to a 2.3 × \times max. speed-up) silently compromise deployment-critical physical constraints that remain entirely invisible to standard visual-quality metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 大规模审计推理加速：我们通过审计 9 种最先进的加速策略（图 1-c），系统性地评估质量与效率之间的权衡，这些策略涵盖词元合并、特征缓存和稀疏注意力，并集成到三个领先的世界模型 DreamGen（Jang et al., 2025）、DreamDojo（Gao et al., 2026）和 Ctrl-World（Guo et al., 2026）中。 通过评估超过 29,000 个生成的 rollout，我们揭示了计算捷径（最高可带来 2.3 × \times 的加速）如何悄然损害部署中至关重要的物理约束，而这些损害在标准的视觉质量指标下完全不可见。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation shows that visually convincing robotic videos can suffer substantial kinematic and multi-view inconsistencies that standard metrics and VLM judges miss. Such failures compounding over longer rollouts. RoboWorM exposes these deployment-critical failures and quantifies the speed–integrity trade-off under acceleration, enabling evaluation beyond perceptual quality alone. We will make our benchmark and code publicly available upon acceptance for further research.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估表明，视觉上令人信服的机器人视频可能存在显著的运动学和多视角不一致问题，而标准指标和VLM裁判往往无法发现这些不一致。 此类失败会在更长的执行过程中不断累积。 RoboWorM能够暴露这些对部署至关重要的失败，并量化加速条件下速度与完整性的权衡，从而实现超越单纯感知质量的评估。 论文被接收后，我们将公开发布我们的基准和代码，以促进进一步研究。

paragraphs.en: Early evaluation frameworks for video generation, such as VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) and EvalCrafter ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , assess perceptual quality, temporal consistency, and prompt alignment using standard visual metrics like Fréchet Video Distance (FVD) ( Unterthiner et al., 2018 ) or CLIP scores ( Radford et al., 2021 ) . While recent robotics suites like RoboTrustBench ( Li et al., 2026c ) and MiraBench ( Yang et al., 2026b ) shift toward physical tasks, they largely rely on subjective VLM judges or zero-shot algorithmic metrics applied without environment-specific adaptation. Conversely, analytical baselines like RoboWM-Bench leverage inverse kinematics (IK) in simulation to check physical consistency; however, such pipelines frequently struggle due to compounding errors during real-to-simulation conversion. In contrast, RoboWorM introduces a deployment-aware paradigm that bypasses both brittle real-to-sim approximations and subjective VLM juries. By leveraging explicit priors such as kinematic URDFs, task instructions, and source videos, KIVA and RIGIS provide deterministic, prior-grounded measurements of intra-view kinematics and inter-view geometry (c.f. Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 早期的视频生成评估框架，如 VBench（Huang et al., 2024）和 EvalCrafter（Liu et al., 2024），使用 Fréchet 视频距离（FVD）（Unterthiner et al., 2018）或 CLIP 分数（Radford et al., 2021）等标准视觉指标来评估感知质量、时间一致性和提示对齐。 虽然最近的机器人套件（如 RoboTrustBench（Li et al., 2026c）和 MiraBench（Yang et al., 2026b））转向了物理任务，但它们在很大程度上依赖主观的 VLM 评审或未经环境特定适配就直接应用的零样本算法指标。 相反，像 RoboWM-Bench 这类分析型基线利用仿真中的逆运动学（IK）来检验物理一致性；然而，由于真实到仿真转换过程中的误差累积，此类流程常常表现不佳。 与之相对，RoboWorM 引入了一种面向部署的范式，既规避了脆弱的真实到仿真近似，也避免了主观的 VLM 评审团。 通过利用运动学 URDF、任务指令和源视频等显式先验，KIVA 和 RIGIS 为视角内运动学和视角间几何提供了确定性的、基于先验的度量（参见 Table 1）。

paragraphs.en: The robotics community has amassed large-scale datasets, most notably Open X-Embodiment ( O’Neill et al., 2024 ) and DROID ( Khazatsky et al., 2025 ) , which have been instrumental in training generalized control policies and video world models. However, benchmark evaluations frequently inherit a narrow subset of this data, heavily biasing assessment toward single-arm, single-view tabletop tasks characterized by short, Markovian dynamics. While recent video world models like MultiWorld ( Wu et al., 2026b ) push the frontier of scalable multi-agent, multi-view generation, and diagnostic suites like MultiView-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) construct multi-view VQA datasets for spatial understanding, their evaluation pipelines still heavily depend on VLMs as judges. The evaluation of complex embodiments and deterministic spatial reasoning in deployment settings remains vastly under-explored. RoboWorM addresses this gap with a diverse benchmark of multi-view, long-horizon tasks across complex embodiments to rigorously evaluate unified 3D state representations (Fig. 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 机器人学社区已经积累了大规模数据集，其中最著名的是 Open X-Embodiment（O’Neill 等，2024）和 DROID（Khazatsky 等，2025），它们对训练通用控制策略和视频世界模型起到了重要作用。 然而，基准评测通常只继承这些数据中狭窄的一个子集，使评估严重偏向单臂、单视角的桌面任务，这类任务以短时程、马尔可夫性动力学为特征。 尽管近期的视频世界模型（如 MultiWorld（Wu 等，2026b））推动了可扩展的多智能体、多视角生成的前沿，诊断套件（如 MultiView-Bench（Zhang 等，2026））构建了用于空间理解的多视角 VQA 数据集，但它们的评估流程仍然严重依赖以 VLM 作为评判者。 部署环境中复杂本体形态与确定性空间推理的评估仍然远未被充分探索。 RoboWorM 通过一个涵盖复杂本体形态的多视角、长时程任务的多样化基准来填补这一空白，以严格评估统一的 3D 状态表示（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models and autoregressive transformers suffer from severe inference latency, limiting their utility in closed-loop robotic control. A rich literature of acceleration techniques has emerged to address this, including token merging/pruning ( Bolya et al., 2023 ; Shao et al., 2026 ; Tran et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025a ) , KV-caching ( Lyu et al., 2025 ; Bu et al., 2026 ; Nawaz et al., 2026 ) , and sparse attention mechanisms ( Xi et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026d ; Li et al., 2026b ) . While these methods report significant speed-ups for standard image and video synthesis, they are almost exclusively evaluated on perceptual metrics (e.g., FVD). Their impact on the physical fidelity of the generated output remains untested. As these methods aggressively compress spatial structure, they risk silently deteriorating kinematic linkage or geometric stability in robotic simulations. RoboWorM provides the first systematic audit of inference acceleration methods specifically for robotic world models, explicitly mapping how computational shortcuts compromise deployment-critical physical constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型和自回归Transformer存在严重的推理延迟，限制了它们在闭环机器人控制中的实用性。 大量加速技术的文献应运而生，包括token合并/剪枝（Bolya et al., 2023；Shao et al., 2026；Tran et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2025a）、KV缓存（Lyu et al., 2025；Bu et al., 2026；Nawaz et al., 2026）以及稀疏注意力机制（Xi et al., 2025；Yang et al., 2026a；Li et al., 2026d；Li et al., 2026b）。 虽然这些方法在标准图像和视频合成中报告了显著的加速效果，但它们几乎只在感知类指标（如FVD）上进行评估。 它们对生成输出的物理保真度的影响仍未得到检验。 由于这些方法激进地压缩空间结构，它们可能悄无声息地损害机器人仿真中的运动学连接或几何稳定性。 RoboWorM首次针对机器人世界模型的推理加速方法进行了系统性审查，明确揭示了计算上的捷径如何损害部署中至关重要的物理约束。

paragraphs.en: RoboWorM evaluates the physical consistency of generated rollouts across embodiments , camera setups , and temporal dynamics . We curate our dataset from five public corpora: DROID ( Khazatsky et al., 2025 ) , RoboChallenge ( Yakefu et al., 2025 ) , AIST Bimanual corpus ( Motoda et al., 2025 ) , RoboCOIN ( Wu et al., 2025b ) , and NVIDIA GR00T Teleop GR1 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , yielding six distinct configurations spanning five robot platforms and three morphology classes (c.f. Fig. 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: RoboWorM 评估生成 rollout 在不同本体、相机设置与时间动态下的物理一致性。 我们从五个公开语料库中整理数据集：DROID（Khazatsky et al., 2025）、RoboChallenge（Yakefu et al., 2025）、AIST 双臂语料库（Motoda et al., 2025）、RoboCOIN（Wu et al., 2025b）以及 NVIDIA GR00T Teleop GR1（Gao et al., 2026），由此得到涵盖五种机器人平台和三种形态类别的六种不同配置（参见图 2）。

sents.en: RoboWorM evaluates the physical consistency of generated rollouts across embodiments , camera setups , and temporal dynamics .
sents.zh: RoboWorM 评估生成 rollout 在不同本体、相机设置与时间动态下的物理一致性。

sents.en: We curate our dataset from five public corpora: DROID ( Khazatsky et al., 2025 ) , RoboChallenge ( Yakefu et al., 2025 ) , AIST Bimanual corpus ( Motoda et al., 2025 ) , RoboCOIN ( Wu et al., 2025b ) , and NVIDIA GR00T Teleop GR1 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , yielding six distinct configurations spanning five robot platforms and three morphology classes (c.f. Fig. 2 ).
sents.zh: 我们从五个公开语料库中整理数据集：DROID（Khazatsky et al., 2025）、RoboChallenge（Yakefu et al., 2025）、AIST 双臂语料库（Motoda et al., 2025）、RoboCOIN（Wu et al., 2025b）以及 NVIDIA GR00T Teleop GR1（Gao et al., 2026），由此得到涵盖五种机器人平台和三种形态类别的六种不同配置（参见图 2）。

paragraphs.en: Each configuration consists of both Markovian and non-Markovian rollouts. For corpora with free-form instructions, temporal dynamics regimes are assigned via automated LLM classification (Qwen3-VL-30B) using sequencing and iterative markers, whereas multi-step instructions use manual task labeling. See Appendix A for dataset-to-configuration mappings, and curation protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 每个配置同时包含马尔可夫与非马尔可夫的回合数据。 对于包含自由形式指令的语料库，时间动态机制通过基于序列性和迭代性标记的自动化 LLM 分类（Qwen3-VL-30B）来分配，而多步指令则采用人工任务标注。 数据集与配置的映射关系及整理协议见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: To systematically examine generation capabilities, we evaluate three video world model families across three backbone architectures: DreamGen ( Jang et al., 2025 ) (scalable general-purpose DiT, 2B/14B), DreamDojo ( Gao et al., 2026 ) (action-conditioned DiT, 2B), and Ctrl-World ( Guo et al., 2026 ) (spatio-temporal U-Net for synchronized multi-view generation). We evaluate 12 checkpoints matched to our setup: nine were explicitly fine-tuned on target domains, while three (Ctrl-World/DreamGen on single-arm/multi-view; DreamDojo on humanoid/single-view) reuse public weights. Configuration and dense-baseline details are deferred to the Appendix C.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了系统地考察生成能力，我们在三种骨干架构上评估了三个视频世界模型家族：DreamGen（Jang et al., 2025）（可扩展的通用 DiT，2B/14B）、DreamDojo（Gao et al., 2026）（动作条件 DiT，2B）以及 Ctrl-World（Guo et al., 2026）（用于同步多视角生成的时空 U-Net）。 我们评估了 12 个与我们的设置相匹配的检查点：其中九个是在目标领域上经过显式微调的，而三个（单臂/多视角上的 Ctrl-World/DreamGen；人形/单视角上的 DreamDojo）复用了公开权重。 配置与稠密基线的细节见附录 C.1。

paragraphs.en: As robotic deployment heavily relies on real-time control, VWMs are increasingly paired with inference acceleration algorithms. We evaluate nine acceleration algorithms against a dense baseline, grouped into three categories: (1) Cache Strategies with FasterCache ( Lyu et al., 2025 ) , DiCache ( Bu et al., 2026 ) , World-Cache ( Nawaz et al., 2026 ) ; (2) Sparse Attention with Sparse VideoGen 1 & 2 ( Xi et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) , Radial Attention ( Li et al., 2026d ) , PISA ( Li et al., 2026b ) ; and (3) Token Pruning with SiTo ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , ITM ( Wu et al., 2025a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 由于机器人部署严重依赖实时控制，世界模型（VWM）正越来越多地与推理加速算法搭配使用。 我们针对一个稠密基线评估了九种加速算法，并将其分为三类：（1）缓存策略，包括 FasterCache（Lyu et al., 2025）、DiCache（Bu et al., 2026）、World-Cache（Nawaz et al., 2026）；（2）稀疏注意力，包括 Sparse VideoGen 1 & 2（Xi et al., 2025; Yang et al., 2026a）、Radial Attention（Li et al., 2026d）、PISA（Li et al., 2026b）；（3）词元剪枝，包括 SiTo（Zhang et al., 2025）、ITM（Wu et al., 2025a）。

paragraphs.en: Intuition and Trajectory Estimation . KIVA (Fig. 3 -a) employs a diagnostic diffusion model g θ g_{\theta} to bridge visual features and 3D kinematics. During training on real-world videos, g θ g_{\theta} is supervised via Huber loss to reconstruct normalized coordinates derived from exact forward kinematics 𝐗 FK = FK ( 𝐬 1 : T ) \mathbf{X}^{\mathrm{FK}}=\operatorname{FK}(\mathbf{s}_{1:T}) , where 𝐬 1 : T \mathbf{s}_{1:T} denotes the robot states obtained across T T frames in real-robot datasets and FK \operatorname{FK} represents the forward kinematics equation, conditioned on DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) visual tokens ℱ τ \mathcal{F}_{\tau} at each frame τ ∈ T \tau\in T . This ground-truth supervision ensures g θ g_{\theta} yields precise, low-variance reconstructions for clean videos. Conversely, we observe that hallucinated videos produce out-of-distribution visual features. Because the diagnostic model is only trained on pristine, real-world data, these anomalous features cause its predictions to become highly unstable, leading to severe divergence across different noise seeds (as illustrated in Fig. 1 -b, left). During inference, we average N N independent DDIM sampling runs ( N = 5 N=5 in our experiment) and apply an inverse workspace transformation. This maps the aggregated diffusion outputs back into the original metric space, yielding the deterministic, un-normalized 3D trajectory 𝐏 τ ​ k \mathbf{P}_{\tau k} . Definitions of the diffusion forward process, workspace transformations, and other parameters are deferred to Appendix B.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 直觉与轨迹估计。 KIVA（图 3-a）采用一个诊断扩散模型 g θ g_{\theta} 来连接视觉特征与三维运动学。 在真实世界视频上进行训练时，g θ g_{\theta} 通过 Huber 损失进行监督，以重构由精确正向运动学得到的归一化坐标 𝐗 FK = FK ( 𝐬 1 : T ) \mathbf{X}^{\mathrm{FK}}=\operatorname{FK}(\mathbf{s}_{1:T})，其中 𝐬 1 : T \mathbf{s}_{1:T} 表示在真实机器人数据集的 T T 帧中获取的机器人状态，FK \operatorname{FK} 表示正向运动学方程，并以每一帧 τ ∈ T \tau\in T 上的 DINOv3（Siméoni et al., 2026）视觉 token ℱ τ \mathcal{F}_{\tau} 为条件。 这种真值监督确保 g θ g_{\theta} 对干净视频产生精确、低方差的重构结果。 相反，我们观察到幻觉视频会产生分布外的视觉特征。 由于诊断模型仅在纯净的真实世界数据上训练，这些异常特征会导致其预测变得高度不稳定，进而在不同噪声种子之间产生严重发散（如图 1-b 左侧所示）。 在推理阶段，我们对 N N 次独立的 DDIM 采样运行取平均（在我们的实验中 N = 5 N=5），并应用逆工作空间变换。 这将聚合后的扩散输出映射回原始度量空间，得到确定性的、未归一化的三维轨迹 𝐏 τ ​ k \mathbf{P}_{\tau k}。 关于扩散前向过程、工作空间变换及其他参数的定义见附录 B.1。

paragraphs.en: While KIVA audits intra-view kinematics, evaluating multi-view models requires verifying cross-camera spatial consistency. Existing metrics often fall short: VLMs lack explicit 3D reasoning, and standard 3D estimators inadvertently smooth over generated geometric hallucinations. We introduce RIGIS to enforce strict multi-camera physical constraints by anchoring its evaluation directly to the underlying spatial layout and dataset’s ground-truth priors (c.f. Fig 3 -b).
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 KIVA 审查的是单一视图内的运动学，但评估多视图模型还需要验证跨相机的空间一致性。 现有指标往往存在不足：视觉语言模型缺乏显式的 3D 推理能力，而标准 3D 估计器会在无意中平滑掉生成的几何幻觉。 我们提出 RIGIS，通过将评估直接锚定在底层空间布局和数据集的真值先验上，来强制执行严格的多相机物理约束（参见 Fig 3-b）。

sents.en: While KIVA audits intra-view kinematics, evaluating multi-view models requires verifying cross-camera spatial consistency.
sents.zh: 虽然 KIVA 审查的是单一视图内的运动学，但评估多视图模型还需要验证跨相机的空间一致性。

paragraphs.en: Multi-View Alignment Pipeline. Rather than blindly estimating spatial parameters, RIGIS leverages the dataset’s known static camera configurations and workspace limits. For a generated rollout, it verifies that reprojected pixels form a unified 3D scene that does not drift from the true robotic setup. At each timestep τ ∈ { 1 ​ … ​ T } \tau\in\{1\dots T\} across all active frames, the multi-view input frames X τ X_{\tau} are processed by a modified VGGT- Ω \Omega backbone ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . An independent prediction head estimates per-view depth maps, while a joint head predicts the camera projection matrix 𝐌 τ = 𝐊 τ ​ [ 𝐑 τ | 𝐭 τ ] \mathbf{M}_{\tau}=\mathbf{K}_{\tau}[\mathbf{R}_{\tau}|{}\mathbf{t}_{\tau}] . These outputs are scale-aligned, fused, and back-projected to generate reconstructed renders ( X ¯ τ , D ¯ τ ) (\bar{X}_{\tau},\bar{D}_{\tau}) within the visible intersection region.

paragraphs.en: Camera Pose Stability. For a fixed robotic setup, the physical camera rig should not drift during generation. RIGIS tracks the temporal standard deviation of the predicted intrinsics ( σ K \sigma_{K} ) and extrinsic relative poses ( σ R , σ t \sigma_{R},\sigma_{t} ) with respect to the initial conditioned frame at τ = 1 \tau=1 . These deviations are mapped to stability scores: S ext = 1 2 ( e − σ R / 5 + e − σ t ) , S int = 1 V ∑ v = 1 V e − σ K ( v ) S_{\mathrm{ext}}=\frac{1}{2}\left(\mathrm{e}^{-\sigma_{R}/5}+\mathrm{e}^{-\sigma_{t}}\right),\quad S_{\mathrm{int}}=\frac{1}{V}\sum_{v=1}^{V}\mathrm{e}^{-\sigma_{K}^{(v)}} yielding the unified pose stability metric S pose = 1 2 ​ ( S ext + S int ) S_{\mathrm{pose}}=\frac{1}{2}(S_{\mathrm{ext}}+S_{\mathrm{int}}) . The final RIGIS score is defined as the unweighted mean of spatial fidelity and rig stability: S = 1 2 ​ ( S geo + S pose ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] S=\frac{1}{2}(S_{\mathrm{geo}}+S_{\mathrm{pose}})\in[0,1] where a higher score strictly indicates that the video world model successfully maintains coherent multi-view 3D state representations without spatial drift. See detailed formulations and calibration in Appendix B.2 .

paragraphs.en: Reference Metrics and Baselines. To complete the evaluation aspects, we incorporate foundational metrics, namely Visual Integrity ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), Text Alignment ( Hessel et al., 2021 ) , and Fréchet Video Distance (FVD) ( Unterthiner et al., 2018 ) . To evaluate automated judging, we use two closed-source (Gemini 3.6 Flash, Qwen 3.6 Plus) and two open-source (Gemma 4 31B, Qwen 3.6 35B) VLMs under zero-shot and CoT settings. See detail description in App. B.3 , and VLM judgement setup in Appendix D.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 参考指标与基线。 为完善评估方面，我们引入了若干基础指标，即视觉完整性（Visual Integrity）（Wang et al., 2023）、峰值信噪比（PSNR）、文本对齐（Text Alignment）（Hessel et al., 2021）以及 Fréchet 视频距离（FVD）（Unterthiner et al., 2018）。 为评估自动化评审，我们在零样本（zero-shot）和思维链（CoT）设置下使用了两个闭源（Gemini 3.6 Flash、Qwen 3.6 Plus）和两个开源（Gemma 4 31B、Qwen 3.6 35B）视觉语言模型（VLM）。 详细描述见附录 B.3，VLM 评审设置见附录 D.2。

paragraphs.en: Score Aggregation. KIVA scores are computed as the mean segment violation rate over single-view rollouts, while RIGIS scores represent the mean per-rollout score under identical pixel inputs. For KIVA, a segment is flagged as a violation when its rigidity or jerk error exceeds the 95th percentile threshold of real-video references ( max ⁡ ( s rig , s jerk ) > 1 \max(s^{\mathrm{rig}},s^{\mathrm{jerk}})>1 ). All scores are normalized relative to real video references. Further details are provided in Appendix B.1 and B.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 分数聚合。 KIVA 分数计算为单视角 rollout 上的平均片段违规率，而 RIGIS 分数表示在相同像素输入下的每次 rollout 的平均分数。 对于 KIVA，当某片段的刚度或加加速度误差超过真实视频参考的第 95 百分位阈值（ max ⁡ ( s rig , s jerk ) > 1 \max(s^{\mathrm{rig}},s^{\mathrm{jerk}})>1 ）时，该片段被标记为违规。 所有分数均相对于真实视频参考进行归一化。 更多细节见附录 B.1 和 B.2。

paragraphs.en: Speedup Measurement. Speedup is defined as the ratio of dense baseline to accelerated generation time per segment, aggregated across all episodes. Timings utilize internal timers to exclude constant overheads like model loading and VAE decoding. Measuring per segment isolates algorithmic efficiency by removing biases from variable episode lengths (c.f. Appendix C.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 加速比测量。 加速比定义为稠密基线与加速后每段生成时间的比值，并在所有回合上聚合。 计时采用内部计时器，以排除模型加载和 VAE 解码等固定开销。 逐段测量可通过消除回合长度变化带来的偏差，从而分离出算法本身的效率（参见附录 C.2）。

paragraphs.en: RQ1: Do KIVA and RIGIS align better with human judgment than VLM judges?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1：KIVA 和 RIGIS 是否比 VLM 评判者更符合人类判断？

paragraphs.en: Fig. 4 shows that our kinematic- and geometry-grounded metrics outperform VLM judges: KIVA improves human-aligned hallucination detection by 25.8% (58.4% to 73.5%) over frontier VLMs, and RIGIS achieves a 130% higher Spearman correlation with human preferences (0.326 to 0.749). Even when equipped with fewshot understanding, the best-performing judge (Gemma 4 31B + CoT) remains below KIVA. Comprehensive results are provided in Appendices D.3 and D.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 图4表明，我们基于运动学和几何的指标优于VLM评判器：KIVA将符合人类判断的幻觉检测性能相比前沿VLM提升了25.8%（从58.4%到73.5%），RIGIS与人类偏好的Spearman相关性高出130%（从0.326到0.749）。 即使配备了少样本理解能力，表现最佳的评判器（Gemma 4 31B + CoT）仍低于KIVA。 完整结果见附录D.3和D.4。

paragraphs.en: RQ3: How do existing metrics correlate with KIVA and RIGIS?
paragraphs.zh: RQ3：现有指标与 KIVA 和 RIGIS 之间的相关性如何？

paragraphs.en: We compare KIVA against baselines like Motion Smoothness (MS) ( Duan et al., 2025 ) and Motion Amplitude Score (MAS) ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , observing they capture only surface transitions and are more sensitive to hallucinations. KIVA instead leverages embodied kinematic constraints to evaluate physical plausibility. Comparing RIGIS to feature matching (MVC) ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) and SLAM RPE ( Wu et al., 2026b ; Wu et al., 2026a ) reveals that conventional pipelines fail under large viewpoints; RIGIS instead evaluates holistic multi-view consistency, aligning closely with human judgment (Fig. 6 -a).

RQ4: How do Video World Models perform across morphologies and long horizons?
paragraphs.zh: RQ4：视频世界模型在不同形态和长时域上的表现如何？

paragraphs.en: Longer rollouts show stronger degradation. KIVA degrades mainly in the two deepest configurations of single-arm DreamGen and DreamDojo, where non-Markovian rollouts have higher rollout depth (i.e., more frames). Their supports are strictly disjoint, meaning regime and rollout depth are completely confounded (Fig 6 -c). This exposes their entanglement rather than isolating depth as the root cause, requiring our causal interpretation to rely instead on the preceding within-clip cascade.
paragraphs.zh: 更长的轨迹回放显示出更强的性能退化。 KIVA 主要在单臂 DreamGen 和 DreamDojo 的两个最深配置中出现退化，这些配置中非马尔可夫轨迹回放具有更高的回放深度（即更多帧数）。 它们的支持集严格不相交，这意味着状态类型与回放深度完全混淆（图 6-c）。 这暴露了二者的纠缠，而不是将回放深度单独隔离为根本原因，因此我们的因果解释只能转而依赖前述片段内的级联分析。

paragraphs.en: Architecture and cross-view consistency. Ctrl-World consistently outperforms DreamGen in RIGIS across all multi-view comparisons (c.f. Tab. 2 ). This stems directly from architectural design: Ctrl-World applies explicit spatial-temporal processing, whereas DreamGen processes a 2 × 2 2\times 2 tiled frame via self-attention without native geometric constraints. Since RIGIS directly measures cross-view consistency, this structural difference naturally explains the observed performance gap.
paragraphs.zh: 架构与跨视角一致性。 如表 2 所示，在所有多视角对比中，Ctrl-World 在 RIGIS 上均持续优于 DreamGen。 这直接源于架构设计：Ctrl-World 采用显式的时空处理，而 DreamGen 通过自注意力处理 2 × 2 2\times 2 的分块帧，缺乏原生的几何约束。 由于 RIGIS 直接衡量跨视角一致性，这一结构性差异自然解释了所观察到的性能差距。

paragraphs.en: RQ5: How does acceleration trade off speed and structural integrity in video world models?
paragraphs.zh: RQ5：加速在视频世界模型中如何在速度与结构完整性之间进行权衡？

paragraphs.en: Caching offers the most robust acceleration , achieving a 1.7 × 1.7\times mean speedup with minimal quality loss ( − 0.004 -0.004 RIGIS) and winning all 12 12 configurations. WorldCache is its strongest member, at 1.8 × 1.8\times mean and a benchmark-best 2.3 × 2.3\times on DreamGen humanoid and single-arm multi-view. Unlike token pruning, which incurs higher error ( 13.4 % 13.4\% NR loss) and slower speeds ( 1.2 × 1.2\times ), or sparse attention (limited by low attention runtimes), caching reuses computation safely across diverse backbone architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 缓存提供了最稳健的加速，实现了 1.7 × 1.7\times 的平均加速比，质量损失极小（−0.004 RIGIS），并在全部 12 12 个配置中获胜。 WorldCache 是其中最强的成员，平均加速 1.8 × 1.8\times，在 DreamGen 人形和单臂多视角基准上达到最佳的 2.3 × 2.3\times。 与会带来更高误差（13.4 % 13.4\% 的 NR 损失）和更慢速度（1.2 × 1.2\times）的 token 剪枝，或稀疏注意力（受限于较低注意力运行时）不同，缓存可以在多种骨干网络架构之间安全地复用计算。

paragraphs.en: Our findings suggest that evaluating video world models requires a shift toward deployment-aware auditing. By grounding metrics in training data distributions and robot kinematics, RoboWorM provides a complementary lens to standard visual assessment. Our analysis indicates that tracking kinematic violations, multi-view consistency, and the trade-offs of inference acceleration help reveal failure modes that are otherwise missed by generic metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，评估视频世界模型需要向面向部署的审计方式转变。 通过将评估指标建立在训练数据分布和机器人运动学之上，RoboWorM 为标准的视觉评估提供了一个互补的视角。 我们的分析表明，追踪运动学违规、多视角一致性以及推理加速带来的权衡，有助于揭示那些被通用指标所忽略的失败模式。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. Our RoboWorM has several limitations: (i) KIVA and RIGIS do not verify contact-level physical validity, which would require integrating full physics simulators; (ii) they are currently limited to rigid-body motions and do not capture deformable materials or force-driven dynamics; and (iii) our acceleration audits measure output-level degradation without identifying which internal layers or layers of computation are responsible for losing physical fidelity. We leave these directions for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 我们的 RoboWorM 存在若干局限：(i) KIVA 和 RIGIS 未验证接触级别的物理有效性，而这需要集成完整的物理模拟器；(ii) 它们目前仅限于刚体运动，无法捕捉可变形材料或力驱动动力学；(iii) 我们的加速审计测量的是输出层面的退化，而未能识别是哪些内部层或哪些计算层导致物理保真度的损失。 我们将这些方向留待未来工作。

paragraphs.en: Five publicly available corpora form the basis of the 12 evaluation settings: DROID (Franka Panda, three cameras) is used for the single-arm multi-view condition, whereas RoboChallenge (ARX-5 and Franka, one static camera) is used for the single-arm single-view condition; the AIST Bimanual corpus (ALOHA, 4 4 cameras) for both bimanual conditions; RoboCOIN (AIRBOT MMK2) for the humanoid multi-view condition; and NVIDIA GR00T Teleop GR1 (GR1-T2 egocentric) for the humanoid single-view condition. Two correspondences are prone to misinterpretation. First, for each embodiment, the multi-view and single-view tracks are sourced from distinct corpora (RoboChallenge vs. DROID; GR1 vs. RoboCOIN) and therefore contribute disjoint sets of episodes; only the two bimanual tracks share episodes. Second, although RoboCOIN logs tasks using two different camera rigs that are denoted by different view identifiers, these recordings constitute a single corpus rather than two separate datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 五个公开可用的语料库构成了12个评测设置的基础：DROID（Franka Panda，三个相机）用于单臂多视角条件，RoboChallenge（ARX-5和Franka，一个静态相机）用于单臂单视角条件；AIST双臂语料库（ALOHA，4个相机）用于两个双臂条件；RoboCOIN（AIRBOT MMK2）用于人形多视角条件；NVIDIA GR00T Teleop GR1（GR1-T2第一视角）用于人形单视角条件。 有两处对应关系容易引起误解。 首先，对于每种本体，多视角与单视角赛道分别来自不同的语料库（RoboChallenge与DROID；GR1与 RoboCOIN），因此它们贡献的片段集合互不重叠；只有两个双臂赛道共享片段。 其次，尽管RoboCOIN使用两种不同的相机配置记录任务，并通过不同的视角标识符加以区分，但这些录制内容构成的是单一语料库，而非两个独立的数据集。

paragraphs.en: Each corpus is split into a Markovian and a non-Markovian subset. A task is Markovian when the next observation follows from the current observation and action (reaching, insertion, pushing, closing), and non-Markovian when correct continuation requires history not visible in the current frame ordered multi-step sequences, deformable manipulation with accumulated state, and hand-over coordination. Where instructions are free-form per episode (DROID, GR1), we assign the label with an LLM classifier over the instruction text (Qwen3-VL-30B at temperature 0 0 ) under a fixed rubric: sequencing connectives ( then , after ), ordinal markers, completion quantifiers ( all , each , remaining ) and iterative verbs ( repeatedly , until ) mark non-Markovian, while a single pick-and-place stays Markovian even when it names two locations; unlabelled episodes are dropped rather than guessed. Where one instruction covers a whole task (bimanual, RoboChallenge), the label is assigned manually per task for instance “put the cup on the coaster” is Markovian, whereas “press three buttons” (prescribed order) and “wipe the table” (pull tissue → \rightarrow wipe → \rightarrow discard) are not. The bimanual contrast in Table A2 follows: its Markovian subset is dominated by gear, shaft and USB insertion, its non-Markovian subset by towel folding and hand-over.
paragraphs.zh: 每个语料库被划分为马尔可夫子集和非马尔可夫子集。 当下一观测可由当前观测和动作推出（够取、插入、推、闭合）时，任务为马尔可夫的；当正确的后续动作需要当前帧中不可见的历史信息（有序的多步序列、具有累积状态的可变形物体操作以及交接协作）时，任务为非马尔可夫的。 对于指令逐回合自由给出的语料库（DROID、GR1），我们使用一个对指令文本进行判别的 LLM 分类器（Qwen3-VL-30B，temperature 为 0.0），依据固定的判定规则来赋予标签：顺序连接词（then、after）、序数标记、完成量词（all、each、remaining）和迭代动词（repeatedly、until）标记为非马尔可夫，而单次抓取-放置即使涉及两个位置也保持为马尔可夫；未标注的回合被直接丢弃而不做猜测。 对于一条指令覆盖整个任务的情况（双臂、RoboChallenge），标签按任务手动赋予，例如“把杯子放到杯垫上”为马尔可夫，而“按三个按钮”（规定顺序）和“擦桌子”（拉纸巾 → 擦拭 → 丢弃）则不是。 表 A2 中的双臂对比即是如此：其马尔可夫子集主要由齿轮、轴和 USB 插入构成，其非马尔可夫子集主要由毛巾折叠和交接构成。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation settings are capped to keep evaluation cost comparable across 9 9 acceleration methods and 3 3 generators, but the caps are not uniform. DROID and GR1 are sampled to 130 130 episodes per regime with a fixed seed; RoboChallenge takes 60 60 episodes per task, two tasks per regime. The bimanual and humanoid multi-view settings are ingested exhaustively, so their counts are determined by the source release rather than by a configured target. Two source pools substantially exceed their caps: DROID contains 95,600 95{,}600 episodes, while the humanoid non-Markovian tasks provide 376 376 . Table A1 reports both the available pool and the selected subset to make the sampling ratio explicit. The DROID pool is further restricted to the subset of shards downloaded for this study.

paragraphs.en: Preparation converts curated episodes into each generator’s native input format. The three generator families impose different spatial, temporal and view-composition conventions, and we match each one’s training configuration exactly, so that measured differences reflect the acceleration method rather than an input-distribution shift.
paragraphs.zh: 准备阶段将筛选好的情节片段转换为每个生成器的原生输入格式。 三类生成器家族在空间、时间与视角构成上遵循不同的约定，我们精确匹配每个生成器的训练配置，从而使测量到的差异反映的是加速方法本身，而非输入分布的变化。

sents.en: Preparation converts curated episodes into each generator’s native input format.
sents.zh: 准备阶段将筛选好的情节片段转换为每个生成器的原生输入格式。

sents.en: The three generator families impose different spatial, temporal and view-composition conventions, and we match each one’s training configuration exactly, so that measured differences reflect the acceleration method rather than an input-distribution shift.
sents.zh: 三类生成器家族在空间、时间与视角构成上遵循不同的约定，我们精确匹配每个生成器的训练配置，从而使测量到的差异反映的是加速方法本身，而非输入分布的变化。

paragraphs.en: Frames are resized to the resolution the corresponding checkpoint was trained at: 320 × 192 320{\times}192 per view for Ctrl-World, 384 × 216 384{\times}216 per quadrant for the DreamGen multi-view grid, 640 × 480 640{\times}480 or 768 × 432 768{\times}432 for single-view DreamGen, and 640 × 480 640{\times}480 for DreamDojo. Resizing is a direct bilinear resample with no letterboxing or aspect-preserving crop, so source aspect ratios are not preserved GR1’s 1280 × 800 1280{\times}800 egocentric frames and DROID’s 320 × 180 320{\times}180 frames are both stretched into the target grid. This is the transform the generators were fine-tuned under, but it means absolute pixel-space metrics are not comparable across settings of differing source geometry. All comparisons in the paper are therefore made within a cell, where every method sees pixel-identical inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 帧会被缩放到相应检查点训练时所用的分辨率：Ctrl-World 每个视角为 320 × 192 320{\times}192，DreamGen 多视角网格每个象限为 384 × 216 384{\times}216，单视角 DreamGen 为 640 × 480 640{\times}480 或 768 × 432 768{\times}432，DreamDojo 为 640 × 480 640{\times}480。 缩放是直接的双线性重采样，不加黑边也不做保持长宽比的裁剪，因此源长宽比不会被保留——GR1 的 1280 × 800 1280{\times}800 第一人称帧和 DROID 的 320 × 180 320{\times}180 帧都会被拉伸到目标网格。 这是各生成器微调时所采用的变换，但这意味着在源几何不同的设置之间，绝对像素空间的指标不可比。 因此论文中的所有比较都在同一单元格内进行，此时每种方法看到的输入在像素上完全相同。

paragraphs.en: Source frame rates differ ( 30 30 FPS for ALOHA and AIRBOT MMK2, 20 20 FPS for GR1, 15 15 FPS for DROID and RoboChallenge). Each generator is fed at its trained rate by integer frame striding, and the emitted clip declares the resulting effective rate: 5 5 FPS for Ctrl-World, 16 16 FPS for DreamGen ( 10 10 FPS for its 14 14 B DROID model), and 10 10 – 15 15 FPS for DreamDojo. Integer striding cannot hit every target rate exactly from every source, so we measure the realised frame rate, frame count and duration on the generated clips rather than assuming them. Clips are generated to match their ground-truth episode length, so duration varies within every cell (Fig. A1 b).
paragraphs.zh: 源帧率各不相同（ALOHA 和 AIRBOT MMK2 为 30 FPS，GR1 为 20 FPS，DROID 和 RoboChallenge 为 15 FPS）。 每个生成器通过整数帧跳取以其训练时的帧率接收输入，并且输出的片段会声明由此得到的有效帧率：Ctrl-World 为 5 FPS，DreamGen 为 16 FPS（其 14 B 的 DROID 模型为 10 FPS），DreamDojo 为 10–15 FPS。 整数跳取无法从每个源精确命中每个目标帧率，因此我们在生成的片段上测量实际实现的帧率、帧数和时长，而不是直接假定它们。 片段的生成长度与其真实片段（episode）长度相匹配，因此每个单元格内的时长都有所变化（图 A1 b）。

sents.en: Source frame rates differ ( 30 30 FPS for ALOHA and AIRBOT MMK2, 20 20 FPS for GR1, 15 15 FPS for DROID and RoboChallenge).
sents.zh: 源帧率各不相同（ALOHA 和 AIRBOT MMK2 为 30 FPS，GR1 为 20 FPS，DROID 和 RoboChallenge 为 15 FPS）。

sents.en: Each generator is fed at its trained rate by integer frame striding, and the emitted clip declares the resulting effective rate: 5 5 FPS for Ctrl-World, 16 16 FPS for DreamGen ( 10 10 FPS for its 14 14 B DROID model), and 10 10 – 15 15 FPS for DreamDojo.

sents.zh: 片段的生成长度与其真实片段（episode）长度相匹配，因此每个单元格内的时长都有所变化（图 A1 b）。

paragraphs.en: None of the three generators natively emits N N independent synchronised streams, so multi-view generation uses a single composed canvas. Ctrl-World composes a horizontal 3 × 1 3{\times}1 latent strip ( 960 × 192 960{\times}192 ), or a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 canvas ( 1280 × 192 1280{\times}192 ) in its four-view variant. DreamGen composes a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 pixel grid ( 768 × 432 768{\times}432 ) with fixed slot assignment: for bimanual ALOHA, the two external views on top and the left and right wrist cameras below. When a cell offers only three active views, the fourth quadrant is filled with a black frame and the prompt states that the quadrant is inactive, so the model is not asked to hallucinate a camera; that quadrant is excluded from all metrics. View subsetting is also a real reduction the Ctrl-World bimanual configuration drops one external view so Views in Table A1 upper-bounds the views actually generated.
paragraphs.zh: 三种生成器都无法原生输出 N N 路相互独立的同步流，因此多视角生成采用单一组合画布。 Ctrl-World 将潜在表示组合为一条水平的 3 × 1 3{\times}1 条带（ 960 × 192 960{\times}192 ），或在其四视角变体中组合为 2 × 2 2{\times}2 画布（ 1280 × 192 1280{\times}192 ）。 DreamGen 将像素组合为 2 × 2 2{\times}2 网格（ 768 × 432 768{\times}432 ），并采用固定的槽位分配：对于双臂 ALOHA，两个外部视角位于上方，左右腕部相机位于下方。 当某个格子只有三个活跃视角时，第四象限用黑色帧填充，并在提示中说明该象限处于非活跃状态，因此不会要求模型凭空生成一台相机；该象限被排除在所有指标之外。 视角子集选择也是一种真实的缩减——Ctrl-World 的双臂配置会舍弃一个外部视角，因此表 A1 中的 Views 是实际生成视角数的上界。

paragraphs.en: Instructions are neither authored by us nor model-generated: each is taken verbatim from the source corpus metadata, preserving the string shown to the teleoperator. Granularity is consequently heterogeneous per-task corpora carry one instruction per task ( 34 34 for bimanual Markovian, 2 2 for humanoid multi-view Markovian), whereas DROID and GR1 carry a near-unique instruction per episode ( 127 127 and 118 118 ). Upstream label noise is inherited as well: the GR1 subset substitutes scene identifiers and degenerate labels ( invalid , empty strings) for some instructions. We keep those episodes, since a world model must still produce plausible motion under a degenerate prompt, but we exclude the non-instruction strings when computing the taxonomy of Appendix A.3 . Generators that expect a descriptive caption receive the task string inserted into a fixed template declaring the grid layout; the template is a deterministic substitution, with no per-episode rewriting or VLM captioning.
paragraphs.zh: 指令既非由我们撰写，也非由模型生成：每条指令都逐字取自源语料库元数据，保留了呈现给遥操作员的原字符串。 因此粒度是异构的：按任务组织的语料库每个任务只有一条指令（双臂马尔可夫数据集为 34 条，人形多视角马尔可夫数据集为 2 条），而 DROID 和 GR1 则几乎每个回合对应一条独立指令（分别为 127 条和 118 条）。 上游的标签噪声也被一并继承：GR1 子集中部分指令被替换成了场景标识符和退化标签（invalid、空字符串）。 我们保留了这些回合，因为世界模型在退化提示下仍需生成合理的运动，但在计算附录 A.3 的分类体系时，我们排除了这些非指令字符串。 期望获得描述性说明文本的生成器会接收被插入到声明网格布局的固定模板中的任务字符串；该模板是一种确定性替换，不进行逐回合改写，也不使用视觉语言模型生成说明。

paragraphs.en: Action and state vectors are truncated to the dimensionality each checkpoint expects ( 14 14 -D joint-plus-gripper for bimanual ALOHA; 7 7 -D Cartesian or 8 8 -D joint, plus gripper, for Ctrl-World single-arm) and strided by the same factor as the frames, keeping action and observation indices aligned. Action-conditioned models normalise proprioception with per-dimension 1 1 st/ 99 99 th percentile statistics, so every method within a cell shares one fixed normaliser. We note that these percentiles are computed over the prepared episodes rather than held out from them. This does not confound our comparisons, which are always between methods sharing a normaliser, but absolute reconstruction numbers should not be read as out-of-sample generalisation.
paragraphs.zh: 动作向量和状态向量被截断到每个检查点所期望的维度（双臂 ALOHA 为 14 14 维关节加夹爪；Ctrl-World 单臂为 7 7 维笛卡尔或 8 8 维关节，再加夹爪），并按与帧相同的步长因子进行采样，以保持动作与观测索引对齐。 动作条件模型使用逐维度的 1 1 分位/99 99 分位统计量来归一化本体感知，因此同一单元格内的每种方法共享同一个固定的归一化器。 我们指出，这些分位数是在准备好的回合（episode）上计算的，而不是从中留出（held out）的。 这不会混淆我们的比较，因为比较始终是在共享同一归一化器的方法之间进行的，但绝对的重建数值不应被解读为样本外泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: An episode is included only when its trajectory data and all required view videos are present and decodable. Episodes with missing streams are dropped rather than padded, which is why per-setting video counts do not exactly equal episodes × \times views. For example, three DROID episodes retain their trajectory files but contain only two of the three required streams, leaving 128 128 and 129 129 episodes in the single-arm multi-view settings rather than the 130 130 initially sampled per regime. Trajectory rows are re-aligned to the decoded frame count to prevent index drift.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当某一回合的轨迹数据及所有必需视角的视频都存在且可解码时，该回合才会被收录。 缺失数据流的回合会被直接丢弃而非填充，这就是为什么各设置下的视频数量并不完全等于回合数 \times 视角数。 例如，有三个 DROID 回合保留了轨迹文件，但三个必需数据流中只有两个，因此在单臂多视角设置下分别只有 128 128 和 129 129 个回合，而不是每种机制最初采样的 130 130 个。 轨迹行会与解码后的帧数重新对齐，以防止索引漂移。

paragraphs.en: We apply no success filter: DROID’s success flag is never used as a selection criterion, so failed demonstrations are retained. No minimum-length filter is applied, yielding retained trajectories from 4 4 to 3,000 3{,}000 frames. A maximum-length filter is applied only to RoboChallenge, where episodes exceeding a task-specific bound ( 25 25 – 50 50 s) are excluded and the remainder are selected shortest-first, biasing that setting toward shorter executions. Retaining failed and degenerate trajectories is deliberate for an audit benchmark, as these cases are particularly informative for evaluating failures in physical consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 我们不使用成功过滤器：DROID 的成功标志从不作为筛选标准，因此失败的演示数据会被保留。 不应用最短长度过滤，保留的轨迹长度从 4 4 到 3,000 3{,}000 帧不等。 仅对 RoboChallenge 应用最长长度过滤，其中超过特定任务上限（25 25 – 50 50 秒）的片段被剔除，其余按从短到长的顺序选取，使该设置偏向较短的执行过程。 对于审计型基准而言，保留失败和退化的轨迹是有意为之，因为这些案例对评估物理一致性方面的失效尤其具有参考价值。

paragraphs.en: RoboWorM imposes no external ontology. We instead group the 509 509 distinct instructions present in the benchmark into canonical manipulation primitives by splitting each instruction into clauses and mapping each clause’s leading verb onto a primitive. The lexicon is auditable: any unmatched verb is reported as unmapped rather than silently bucketed, and the current lexicon leaves none of the 509 509 unmapped. The taxonomy is thus a grouping of measured strings , not a label applied to episodes 45 45 distinct leading verbs collapse into 14 14 primitives.
paragraphs.zh: RoboWorM 不强加任何外部本体。 我们转而将基准中出现的 509 条不同指令归类为规范的操作原语，方法是将每条指令拆分为子句，并把每个子句的起始动词映射到某个原语上。 该词表是可审计的：任何未能匹配的动词都会被报告为未映射，而不是被静默归入某个类别，且当前词表中 509 条指令没有一条处于未映射状态。 因此，该分类体系是对测得字符串的分组，而非施加于回合片段的标签——45 个不同的起始动词被归并为 14 个原语。

paragraphs.en: Counting each instruction by its first verb, the benchmark covers pick & place ( 306 306 ), push/slide ( 56 56 ), remove/extract ( 44 44 ), insert/assemble ( 23 23 ), open/close ( 21 21 ), fold/unfold ( 15 15 ), press/actuate ( 15 15 ), wipe/clean ( 12 12 ), pour ( 7 7 ), stack ( 4 4 ), hand-over ( 3 3 ), and one instruction each for sort, hang/cover and draw/trace. We therefore treat the taxonomy as evidence of coverage breadth rather than as a balanced factor, and report no per-primitive metrics for the tail. paragraphs.en: Intuition and Overview. KIVA employs a diagnostic diffusion model trained to predict 3D robot keypoints from visual features. While real-world videos yield precise, low-variance keypoint reconstructions, hallucinated videos produce out-of-distribution features that cause diffusion predictions to diverge heavily across noise seeds. Averaging these estimates isolates the visual distortions into a measurable 3D trajectory. We then evaluate two physical properties on this trajectory: (i) Rigidity , which flags instances where the distance between predicted keypoints exceeds the robot’s known hardware bone lengths, and (ii) Jerk , which measures anomalous acceleration to detect abrupt temporal discontinuities. These metrics are normalized against real-world video baselines and then thresholded at a level calibrated against human judgment.
paragraphs.zh: 直觉与概述。 KIVA 采用一个诊断性扩散模型，该模型经训练可从视觉特征预测三维机器人关键点。 真实世界视频能产生精确、低方差的关键点重建，而幻觉视频则产生分布外特征，导致扩散模型在不同噪声种子下的预测严重发散。 对这些估计取平均，可将视觉失真隔离成一条可测量的三维轨迹。 然后我们在这条轨迹上评估两个物理属性：（i）刚性，用于标记预测关键点之间的距离超过机器人已知硬件骨骼长度的实例；（ii）加加速度，用于测量异常加速度以检测突然的时间不连续。 这些指标先以真实世界视频为基线进行归一化，再按依据人类判断校准的阈值进行判定。

paragraphs.en: This appendix provides the detailed mathematical formulation of RIGIS ( R obotic I nter-view G eometry & I ntrinsic-extrinsic S tability) expanding Sec. 3.4.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 本附录提供了 RIGIS（ R obotic I nter-view G eometry & I ntrinsic-extrinsic S tability，机器人视角间几何与内外参稳定性）的详细数学公式推导，是对第 3.4.2 节的扩展。

paragraphs.en: Under a rigid multi-camera setup, evaluating the cross-view physical consistency of a generated video rollout requires verifying two fundamental geometric requirements: (i) all camera views must capture a single, unified 3D scene without structural hallucination, and (ii) the camera calibration parameters must remain temporally invariant across the rollout. To assess these properties without reliance on ground-truth 3D geometry or VLM-based heuristics, RIGIS integrates two reference-free, bounded components in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] : geometric consistency ( S geo S_{\mathrm{geo}} ) and camera pose stability ( S pose S_{\mathrm{pose}} ).
paragraphs.zh: 在刚性多相机设置下，评估生成视频rollout的跨视角物理一致性需要验证两个基本的几何要求：(i) 所有相机视角必须捕捉同一个统一的3D场景，且不出现结构性幻觉；(ii) 相机标定参数在整个rollout过程中必须保持时序不变。 为了在不依赖真值3D几何或基于VLM的启发式方法的情况下评估这些属性，RIGIS集成了两个无参考且有界的组件，取值范围在 [0,1] 内：几何一致性（S_geo）和相机位姿稳定性（S_pose）。

paragraphs.en: This section specifies the four reference-free metrics reported in Sec. 4.1 . We first define the common preprocessing pipeline shared across metrics, followed by the formulation, implementation, and validity conditions of each metric. We additionally describe the aggregation protocol, motion-confound analysis, and three auxiliary quantities that were computed during development but excluded from the final benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 本节规定第 4.1 节中报告的四个无参考指标的细节。 我们首先定义各指标共用的预处理流程，随后给出每个指标的公式、实现与有效性条件。 我们还描述了聚合协议、运动混淆因素分析，以及开发过程中计算但未纳入最终基准的三项辅助量。

paragraphs.en: We measure frame-level visual quality using CLIP-IQA+ ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . For each sampled frame, CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) estimates the probability of the prompt ”Good photo.” relative to ”Bad photo.”, yielding a score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . Rather than using the temporal mean of the original metric, we report the 10 t ​ h 10^{th} percentile across frames, multiplied by 100 100 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 CLIP-IQA+（Wang et al., 2023）来衡量帧级视觉质量。 对于每个采样帧，CLIP（Radford et al., 2021）估计提示词“Good photo.”相对于“Bad photo.”的概率，得到一个 [0,1] 区间内的分数。 我们不使用原始指标的时间均值，而是报告各帧的第 10 百分位数，并乘以 100。

paragraphs.en: Adaptation. Extracting this clause is important for our benchmark because DreamGen prompts append a description of the 2 × 2 2\times 2 grid layout, which is incompatible with a cropped single view and can push the task text beyond CLIP’s 77 77 -token limit. This metric is applicable only to text-conditioned models. Image-only models never receive the instruction and are therefore marked as None rather than assigned a low score. Per-model real-video anchors are treated as text-conditioned because they correspond to real recordings of the same instructed task.

paragraphs.en: Fréchet Video Distance (FVD) ( Unterthiner et al., 2018 ) measures the distance between the distributions of generated and real videos in I3D feature space and is therefore evaluated at the set level rather than per rollout. We extract Kinetics-400 I3D features from consecutive 16 16 -frame windows resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 . For each embodiment × \times camera × \times regime, all models and acceleration methods share the same fixed real-video reference pool. Multi-view predictions are evaluated per camera and averaged over cameras common to all configurations. Videos are sampled at a common 5 5 fps before feature extraction, and duplicate reference clips are removed. Because FVD is sensitive to sample count and evaluation protocol, we use it only for comparisons sharing the same reference and sampling configuration, rather than for absolute comparisons across benchmark settings.
paragraphs.zh: Fréchet 视频距离（FVD）（Unterthiner et al., 2018）在 I3D 特征空间中度量生成视频与真实视频分布之间的距离，因此是在集合层面而非逐次 rollout 进行评估的。 我们从缩放至 224 × 224 的连续 16 帧窗口中提取 Kinetics-400 I3D 特征。 对于每个具身形态 × 相机 × 设定组合，所有模型和加速方法共享同一固定的真实视频参考池。 多视角预测按相机逐一评估，并在所有配置共有的相机上取平均。 视频在特征提取前统一采样为 5 fps，并去除重复的参考片段。 由于 FVD 对样本数量和评估协议较为敏感，我们仅将其用于共享相同参考与采样配置的比较，而非跨基准设置的绝对比较。

paragraphs.en: PSNR is used as the representative pixel-level fidelity metric in the aggregate retention index, while SSIM and LPIPS are retained for per-cell analysis to avoid over-weighting highly correlated appearance measures. Following prior acceleration benchmarks, we report PSNR relative to the corresponding dense rollout rather than treating real video as a PSNR ceiling. Because PSNR is logarithmic, degradation severity is reported in dB when comparing across settings, while normalized retention is used only within a shared dense baseline.
paragraphs.zh: PSNR 作为聚合保持指标中代表性的像素级保真度度量，而 SSIM 和 LPIPS 则保留用于逐单元格分析，以避免对高度相关的外观类指标赋予过高权重。 遵循先前的加速基准测试，我们报告相对于相应稠密 rollout 的 PSNR，而不是把真实视频当作 PSNR 的上限。 由于 PSNR 是对数尺度，在跨设置比较时以 dB 报告退化程度，而归一化保持率仅在共享同一稠密基线时使用。

paragraphs.en: This appendix documents how the benchmark’s generators were produced and configured. paragraphs.en: RoboWorM evaluates acceleration methods within fixed base world models rather than comparing the base models themselves. Their training protocols are reported because the corresponding dense models define the reference for all speedup and quality-retention measurements. We use three families: Ctrl-World, an SVD image-to-video U-Net, and DreamGen and DreamDojo, both Cosmos-Predict2 diffusion transformers, spanning the 12 12 configurations in Table C1 .
paragraphs.zh: RoboWorM 在固定的基础世界模型内部评估加速方法，而不是对基础模型本身进行比较。 我们报告了它们的训练协议，因为相应的稠密模型定义了所有加速比和质量保持度量的参考基准。 我们使用三个系列：Ctrl-World、一个 SVD 图像到视频 U-Net，以及 DreamGen 和 DreamDojo（两者均为 Cosmos-Predict2 扩散 Transformer），涵盖表 C1 中的 12 种配置。

sents.en: RoboWorM evaluates acceleration methods within fixed base world models rather than comparing the base models themselves.
sents.zh: RoboWorM 在固定的基础世界模型内部评估加速方法，而不是对基础模型本身进行比较。

sents.en: We use three families: Ctrl-World, an SVD image-to-video U-Net, and DreamGen and DreamDojo, both Cosmos-Predict2 diffusion transformers, spanning the 12 12 configurations in Table C1 .
sents.zh: 我们使用三个系列：Ctrl-World、一个 SVD 图像到视频 U-Net，以及 DreamGen 和 DreamDojo（两者均为 Cosmos-Predict2 扩散 Transformer），涵盖表 C1 中的 12 种配置。

paragraphs.en: Ctrl-World generated additional configurations beyond those included in the reported benchmark grid. For bimanual and humanoid multi-view episodes, we generated both a 3 × 1 3{\times}1 three-camera latent strip and a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 four-camera latent canvas. We report only the four-view variant because it supersedes the three-view layout on the same episodes, while using an additional camera, a separate checkpoint, and a distinct acceleration profile. For example, WorldCache speedup on bimanual increases from 1.27 × 1.27\times to 1.81 × 1.81\times . Reporting both layouts would duplicate the same episodes under two configurations of the same model. Single-arm retains the three-view strip because no four-view counterpart exists. Accordingly, the reported Ctrl-World layout is embodiment-specific and is identified explicitly in each table. The excluded rollouts and run scripts remain in the release for reproducibility, while the main benchmark uses the 12 12 configurations in Table C1 .
paragraphs.zh: Ctrl-World 生成了超出所报告基准测试网格之外的额外配置。 对于双臂和人形多视角片段，我们同时生成了 3 × 1 3{\times}1 三相机潜在条带和 2 × 2 2{\times}2 四相机潜在画布。 我们仅报告四视角变体，因为在相同的片段上它取代了三视角布局，尽管它使用了额外的相机、单独的检查点和不同的加速配置。 例如，WorldCache 在双臂任务上的加速比从 1.27 × 1.27\times 提升到 1.81 × 1.81\times。 同时报告两种布局会在同一模型的两种配置下重复相同的片段。 单臂保留了三视角条带，因为不存在对应的四视角版本。 因此，所报告的 Ctrl-World 布局是依本体而定的，并在每个表格中明确标识。 被排除的 rollout 和运行脚本仍保留在发布版本中以供复现，而主基准测试使用表 C1 中的 12 12 个配置。

paragraphs.en: Each model family requires a different input representation, summarized in Table C2 . Ctrl-World uses precomputed latents: 30 30 fps multi-view recordings are subsampled to 5 5 fps, resized to 320 × 192 320{\times}192 per view, VAE-encoded, and paired with a 12 12 -D end-effector pose action. Although the raw robot actions are 36 36 -D and 54 54 -D, the shared 12 12 -D pose interface enables a common model across embodiments. DreamGen operates on RGB clips with text conditioning. Its four camera streams are composed into a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 grid, allowing a single-view video backbone to process multi-view data without architectural changes; text embeddings are computed per clip, and long recordings are segmented into overlapping windows. DreamDojo consumes episodes directly and uses conditioning from a frozen latent action model rather than proprioceptive signals.
paragraphs.zh: 每个模型系列都需要不同的输入表示，总结见表 C2。 Ctrl-World 使用预计算的潜变量：将 30 30 fps 的多视角录像下采样至 5 5 fps，每个视角调整为 320 × 192 320{\times}192，经 VAE 编码，并与 12 12 维末端执行器位姿动作配对。 尽管原始机器人动作分别为 36 36 维和 54 54 维，但共享的 12 12 维位姿接口使得同一模型能够跨不同本体使用。 DreamGen 处理带有文本条件的 RGB 视频片段。 它将四路相机流合成为 2 × 2 2{\times}2 网格，使单视角视频骨干网络无需架构改动即可处理多视角数据；文本嵌入按片段计算，长录像被切分为重叠窗口。 DreamDojo 直接消费回合数据，并使用来自冻结的潜动作模型的条件信息，而非本体感受信号。

paragraphs.en: All three model families are fully finetuned without LoRA or other parameter-efficient adapters. The released checkpoints therefore contain full model weights, with per-configuration identifiers reported in Table C1 .
paragraphs.zh: 所有三个模型系列均在完全不使用 LoRA 或其他参数高效适配器的情况下进行全量微调。 因此，发布的检查点包含完整的模型权重，每个配置的标识符见表 C1。

paragraphs.en: Table C3 gives the protocol of each family, read out of the configuration that produced its checkpoints. The three recipes are not matched, and we do not claim they are: peak learning rates span an order of magnitude ( 1 × 10 − 5 1{\times}10^{-5} for Ctrl-World, 2 − 14.5 2^{-14.5} for DreamGen, 1 × 10 − 4 1{\times}10^{-4} for DreamDojo), the U-Net trains in fp16 while both transformers train in bf16 , and clip lengths and frame rates differ by construction because each backbone inherits the released recipe of its upstream model. We therefore compare acceleration methods down a column and never across columns; a cross-family quality gap in this paper reflects the generators as published, not a controlled comparison of architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 表 C3 给出了每个模型系列的协议，读取自产生其检查点的配置。 这三个配方并不匹配，我们也不声称它们匹配：峰值学习率相差一个数量级（Ctrl-World 为 1 × 10 − 5 1{\times}10^{-5}，DreamGen 为 2 − 14.5 2^{-14.5}，DreamDojo 为 1 × 10 − 4 1{\times}10^{-4}），U-Net 以 fp16 训练而两个 transformer 以 bf16 训练，且由于每个骨干模型继承其上游模型已发布的配方，剪辑长度和帧率在构造上就各不相同。 因此，我们只在同一列内比较加速方法，绝不做跨列比较；本文中跨系列的质量差异反映的是各生成器发布时的状态，而非对架构的受控比较。

paragraphs.en: Ctrl-World is trained with Accelerate data parallelism using a micro-batch size of 1 1 , while DreamGen and DreamDojo use FSDP across all ranks. DreamGen additionally uses context parallelism of degree 2 2 during training, which is disabled for accelerated inference because the evaluated caching and sparse-attention methods do not support it. All rollouts and timing measurements are performed on a single A100-80GB (Appendix C.2 ). Sampling settings, including denoising steps, guidance scale, and seeds, are reported in Table C1 . DreamGen and DreamDojo use deterministic seed schedules, whereas Ctrl-World is unseeded; therefore, small differences between Ctrl-World methods may reflect sampling variance. We report single-run results without seed-wise error bars and interpret within-family comparisons accordingly.
paragraphs.zh: Ctrl-World 使用 Accelerate 数据并行进行训练，微批次大小为 1 1，而 DreamGen 和 DreamDojo 在所有进程上使用 FSDP。 DreamGen 在训练时额外使用了并行度为 2 2 的上下文并行，但由于所评估的缓存与稀疏注意力方法不支持该机制，在加速推理时被禁用。 所有 rollout 与计时测量均在单块 A100-80GB 上进行（附录 C.2）。 采样设置，包括去噪步数、引导比例和种子，见表 C1。 DreamGen 和 DreamDojo 使用确定性的种子调度，而 Ctrl-World 不使用种子；因此，Ctrl-World 各方法之间的微小差异可能反映了采样方差。 我们报告单次运行的结果，不含按种子计算的误差条，并据此解读同一家族内部的比较。

sents.en: Ctrl-World is trained with Accelerate data parallelism using a micro-batch size of 1 1 , while DreamGen and DreamDojo use FSDP across all ranks.
sents.zh: Ctrl-World 使用 Accelerate 数据并行进行训练，微批次大小为 1 1，而 DreamGen 和 DreamDojo 在所有进程上使用 FSDP。

sents.en: DreamGen additionally uses context parallelism of degree 2 2 during training, which is disabled for accelerated inference because the evaluated caching and sparse-attention methods do not support it.
sents.zh: DreamGen 在训练时额外使用了并行度为 2 2 的上下文并行，但由于所评估的缓存与稀疏注意力方法不支持该机制，在加速推理时被禁用。

sents.en: All rollouts and timing measurements are performed on a single A100-80GB (Appendix C.2 ).
sents.zh: 所有 rollout 与计时测量均在单块 A100-80GB 上进行（附录 C.2）。

sents.en: Sampling settings, including denoising steps, guidance scale, and seeds, are reported in Table C1 .
sents.zh: 采样设置，包括去噪步数、引导比例和种子，见表 C1。

sents.en: DreamGen and DreamDojo use deterministic seed schedules, whereas Ctrl-World is unseeded; therefore, small differences between Ctrl-World methods may reflect sampling variance.
sents.zh: DreamGen 和 DreamDojo 使用确定性的种子调度，而 Ctrl-World 不使用种子；因此，Ctrl-World 各方法之间的微小差异可能反映了采样方差。

sents.en: We report single-run results without seed-wise error bars and interpret within-family comparisons accordingly.
sents.zh: 我们报告单次运行的结果，不含按种子计算的误差条，并据此解读同一家族内部的比较。

paragraphs.en: Nine methods are benchmarked in three families: token reduction (SiTo, ITM), which shrinks the token sequence entering attention; step caching (WorldCache, DiCache, FasterCache), which reuses a previous step’s residual and skips whole network evaluations; and sparse attention (PISA, SVG, SVG2, Radial), which restricts the attention operator itself.
paragraphs.zh: 在三大类别中对九种方法进行了基准测试：token 削减（SiTo、ITM），缩小进入注意力机制的 token 序列；步缓存（WorldCache、DiCache、FasterCache），复用上一步的残差并跳过整个网络的计算；稀疏注意力（PISA、SVG、SVG2、Radial），对注意力算子本身进行限制。

paragraphs.en: A speedup is defined as the ratio between the generation time of a dense baseline and that of its accelerated counterpart, with seven choices fixing the measurement protocol. Clock — we use each model family’s native generation-time instrumentation: per-episode wall_time_s for Ctrl-World, reported total inference time for DreamGen, and per-segment generation time for DreamDojo. We do not use end-to-end process wall clock, which additionally includes model loading, VAE decoding, metric computation, and other fixed overheads that would systematically push ratios toward 1 1 . Dense denominator — every speedup is normalized by a fresh dense run from the same cell . Concretely, for each accelerated run we rerun the corresponding dense model on the same episode, from the same split, with the same backbone, embodiment, view setting, task-dynamics regime, and pinned generation configuration. Thus, if T dense T_{\mathrm{dense}} and T method T_{\mathrm{method}} denote the paired generation times, we report S = T dense / T method S=T_{\mathrm{dense}}/T_{\mathrm{method}} . The denominator is therefore never a stored global constant, an average taken from another cell, or a previously recorded dense timing. This paired construction is important because dense generation time itself varies across models, embodiments, view configurations, and episode lengths; reusing a denominator from another setting would confound acceleration gains with baseline runtime differences. Isolation : all runs use one GPU and are issued sequentially, with context parallelism disabled; the timing harness rejects a device with another resident process, since measurements under contention characterize the contention rather than the acceleration method. Sample : accelerated and dense runs use the same episodes from both task-dynamics regimes, because generation cost scales with episode length and a Markovian-only sample could misrepresent methods whose savings are length-dependent. Warm-up : the first segment or chunk is reported separately from the steady-state ratio S ss S_{\text{ss}} , because several methods incur a one-off attention-profiling or k k -means cost that would otherwise make the dense baseline appear artificially favorable; S ss S_{\text{ss}} better reflects the cost observed over a long rollout. Absence : if either member of the paired timing is unavailable, no speedup is inferred: the entry is reported as -- rather than interpolated from a neighbouring cell.
paragraphs.zh: 加速比定义为稠密基线的生成时间与其加速版本生成时间之间的比值，并通过七项选择固定测量协议。 计时——我们使用各模型家族原生的生成时间测量工具：Ctrl-World 使用每回合的 wall_time_s，DreamGen 使用报告的总推理时间，DreamDojo 使用每片段的生成时间。 我们不使用端到端进程墙钟时间，因为它还包含模型加载、VAE 解码、指标计算以及其他固定开销，这些会系统性地把比值推向 1。 稠密分母——每个加速比都由同一单元格中一次新运行的稠密模型进行归一化。 具体而言，对于每个加速运行，我们都在相同的回合上、来自相同的划分、使用相同的主干网络、具身形态、视角设置、任务动态机制以及固定的生成配置，重新运行相应的稠密模型。 因此，如果 T dense T_{\mathrm{dense}} 和 T method T_{\mathrm{method}} 表示配对的生成时间，我们报告 S = T dense / T method S=T_{\mathrm{dense}}/T_{\mathrm{method}}。 因此，分母绝不会是存储的全局常数、取自另一单元格的平均值，或先前记录的稠密计时。 这种配对构造非常重要，因为稠密生成时间本身会随模型、具身形态、视角配置和回合长度而变化；复用来自另一设置的分母会把加速收益与基线运行时间差异混淆在一起。 隔离：所有运行均使用单块 GPU 并按顺序发出，禁用上下文并行；计时工具会拒绝存在其他驻留进程的设备，因为在资源争用下的测量刻画的是争用本身而非加速方法。 采样：加速运行与稠密运行使用来自两种任务动态机制的相同回合，因为生成成本随回合长度增长，而仅使用马尔可夫式的采样可能会误判那些节省效果依赖于长度的方法。 预热：第一段或第一个块与稳态比值 S ss S_{\text{ss}} 分开报告，因为若干方法会产生一次性的注意力剖析或 k 均值聚类开销，否则会使稠密基线显得人为有利；S ss S_{\text{ss}} 更能反映长时程滚动中观察到的成本。 缺失：如果配对计时中的任何一方不可用，则不推断加速比：该条目报告为 --，而不是从相邻单元格插值得到。

sents.zh: 预热：第一段或第一个块与稳态比值 S ss S_{\text{ss}} 分开报告，因为若干方法会产生一次性的注意力剖析或 k 均值聚类开销，否则会使稠密基线显得人为有利；S ss S_{\text{ss}} 更能反映长时程滚动中观察到的成本。

paragraphs.en: Aggregation — the ratio is formed between two single generation-time figures of the same cell, S = T dense / T method S=T_{\text{dense}}/T_{\text{method}} , each reduced from that family’s own repeated unit of work rather than from a per-episode total. Reducing timing at the unit level prevents episode length from contaminating the speedup ratio. We verified this empirically rather than assuming it: episode-level totals implicitly scale with the number of generated units and can therefore distort comparisons across clips of different lengths. For example, on Ctrl-World humanoid multi-view, the same WorldCache configuration yielded 0.64 × 0.64\times on a 37-frame clip but 1.71 × 1.71\times on a 61-frame clip, a difference attributable to episode length rather than to the caching mechanism itself. We therefore compute speedup from matched unit-level timings and apply no additional normalization by episode count or duration.
paragraphs.zh: 聚合——比率由同一单元的两个单独生成时间数值构成，S = T dense / T method S=T_{\text{dense}}/T_{\text{method}}，每个数值都从该系列自身重复的工作单元中约简而来，而不是从每一轮（episode）的总计中约简而来。 在单元层面进行时间统计的约简，可以防止回合长度污染加速比。 我们是通过实证验证而非假设得出这一点：回合级总计会随生成单元数量的变化而隐式缩放，因此会扭曲不同长度片段之间的比较。 例如，在 Ctrl-World 人形多视角任务上，同一 WorldCache 配置在 37 帧片段上得到 0.64 × 0.64\times，而在 61 帧片段上得到 1.71 × 1.71\times，这一差异可归因于回合长度，而非缓存机制本身。 因此，我们从匹配的单元级时间数据计算加速比，不再按回合数量或时长做额外归一化。

paragraphs.en: The speedup column combines two distinct timing passes, which are reported separately rather than merged. Most ratios come from each method’s per-cell tuning trial ( † \dagger ), where timing is matched within a cell but the number of evaluated episodes varies across backbones: two episodes for Ctrl-World, one for DreamDojo, and two segments or chunks for DreamGen. Consequently, small differences across cells may partly reflect protocol variation, and these ratios should be interpreted as within-cell comparisons rather than as a globally calibrated cross-cell scale.
paragraphs.zh: 加速比一栏合并了两次不同的计时流程，二者分别报告，而非合并在一起。 大多数比值来自各方法在每个单元格内的调优试验（†），其中在单元格内部计时是对齐的，但在不同主干之间评估的回合数不同：Ctrl-World 为两个回合，DreamDojo 为一个回合，DreamGen 为两个片段或分块。 因此，各单元格之间的细小差异可能部分源于协议上的差异，这些比值应被理解为单元格内部的比较，而非经过全局校准的跨单元格标度。

paragraphs.en: To provide a uniform reference, we additionally run a shared timing pass ( ‡ \ddagger ): one common episode per cell, with every method and its dense baseline timed back-to-back on the same idle GPU. This pass covers all 12 12 dense baselines and 105 105 method–cell scripts, corresponding to 117 117 of the 120 120 possible pairs; the remaining 3 3 have no executable run script. The full pass is estimated to require 8.3 8.3 GPU-hours. At the time of writing, it has completed for one cell, DreamDojo humanoid single-view. This result already illustrates why the two timing sources are kept separate: under the uniform protocol, DiCache reaches 1.56 × 1.56\times , the first measured caching speedup on a DreamDojo backbone, whereas WorldCache reaches only 1.08 × 1.08\times and FasterCache is net-negative at 0.91 × 0.91\times , an ordering not observed in the tuning records for this cell.
paragraphs.zh: 为了提供一个统一的参照，我们额外运行了一次共享计时环节（‡）：每个单元一个共同片段，将每种方法及其稠密基线在同一块空闲 GPU 上背靠背地进行计时。 该环节覆盖了全部 12 个稠密基线和 105 个方法–单元脚本，对应 120 个可能配对中的 117 个；其余 3 个没有可执行的运行脚本。 整个环节预计需要 8.3 个 GPU 小时。 撰写本文时，该环节已在一个单元上完成，即 DreamDojo humanoid single-view。 这一结果已经说明了为什么两个计时来源要保持分离：在统一协议下，DiCache 达到 1.56 倍，这是在 DreamDojo 骨干上首个实测的缓存加速，而 WorldCache 仅达到 1.08 倍，FasterCache 则净为负值，为 0.91 倍，这一排序在该单元的调参记录中并未出现。

paragraphs.en: This appendix provides comprehensive documentation of the evaluation protocols, dataset statistics, implementation setups, and extended empirical findings used to validate KIVA and RIGIS . Specifically, Section D.1 outlines the human annotation protocol, evaluated dataset preparation, evaluation rubrics, and inter-annotator consensus workflows. Section D.2.1 details the automated VLM-as-a-judge infrastructure, including model configurations, multi-turn querying strategies, and prompt engineering templates. Finally, Sections D.3 and D.4 present supplementary results for KIVA and RIGIS, respectively, focusing on their alignment performance and correlation benchmarks against human evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录全面记录了用于验证 KIVA 与 RIGIS 的评估协议、数据集统计信息、实现设置以及扩展的实证结果。 具体而言，第 D.1 节介绍了人工标注协议、评估数据集的准备、评估细则以及标注者间一致性工作流程。 第 D.2.1 节详细说明了自动化的 VLM 作为评判者的基础设施，包括模型配置、多轮查询策略和提示工程模板。 最后，第 D.3 节和第 D.4 节分别展示了 KIVA 和 RIGIS 的补充结果，重点是其对齐性能以及与人工评估相比的相关性基准测试结果。

paragraphs.en: To ensure a rigorous and unbiased assessment across diverse operational conditions, we construct two complementary evaluation corpora extracted systematically from RoboWorM . Each set is carefully balanced across model quality tiers, robotic morphologies, and task dynamics. Table D1 summarizes the fine-grained data distribution across robot morphologies and task dynamics for both evaluation sets.
paragraphs.zh: 为了确保在不同运行条件下进行严谨且无偏倚的评估，我们从 RoboWorM 中系统地提取了两个互补的评估语料库。 每个数据集都在模型质量层级、机器人形态和任务动态方面经过了仔细均衡。 表 D1 总结了两个评估集在不同机器人形态和任务动态上的细粒度数据分布。

paragraphs.en: The assessment of kinematic physical plausibility and multi-view consistency demands distinct evaluation criteria and methodologies.
paragraphs.zh: 运动物理合理性与多视角一致性的评估需要不同的评价标准和方法。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation of embodied kinematic integrity is conducted at the segment level over 3-second windows; thus, a single episode involves multiple evaluation steps depending on its total duration. The detailed qualitative criteria, physical constraint requirements are provided in Box D.1.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 具身运动学完整性的评估是在片段级别上以3秒窗口进行的；因此，单个回合根据其总时长会涉及多个评估步骤。 详细的定性标准和物理约束要求见框 D.1.2。

paragraphs.en: Because the two evaluation criteria target different aspects of video quality, we designed tailored annotation interfaces optimized for each specific task:
paragraphs.zh: 由于这两项评估标准针对的是视频质量的不同方面，我们为每个具体任务设计了经过优化的定制标注界面：

paragraphs.en: Multi-view Consistency: This interface displays two synchronized views side-by-side. Annotators review the entire video clip and assign a single video-level ordinal score using the buttons provided below.
paragraphs.zh: 多视角一致性：该界面并排显示两个同步的视图。 标注者观看完整的视频片段，并使用下方提供的按钮给出一个视频级的序数分数。

sents.zh: 多视角一致性：该界面并排显示两个同步的视图。

sents.en: Annotators review the entire video clip and assign a single video-level ordinal score using the buttons provided below.

paragraphs.en: Embodied Physics: This interface focuses on physical plausibility using a single camera view. The video is segmented into 3-second intervals where the playback pauses at the end of each segment to prompt the annotator for a score before proceeding to the next segment.
paragraphs.zh: 具身物理：该界面通过单一摄像头视角关注物理合理性。 视频被切分为3秒的片段，每个片段播放结束时暂停，提示标注者先打分，然后再继续播放下一个片段。

paragraphs.en: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have been increasingly adopted as automated judges across general multimodal and video generation tasks ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026b ) , their capacity to reliably evaluate fine-grained physical aspects such as geometry and kinematics remains underexplored. To investigate this, we implement a VLM-based evaluation pipeline alongside human raters and our proposed metrics, revealing that current VLMs struggle significantly with capturing spatial-temporal nuances in multi-view consistency and embodied physics.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管视觉语言模型已被越来越多地用作通用多模态任务和视频生成任务的自动评判器，但其可靠评估几何与运动学等细粒度物理属性的能力仍未得到充分探索。 为研究这一问题，我们实现了一条基于视觉语言模型的评估流水线，并结合人类评分者与我们提出的指标，结果显示当前视觉语言模型在捕捉多视角一致性中的时空细微差异以及具身物理方面存在显著困难。

sents.en: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have been increasingly adopted as automated judges across general multimodal and video generation tasks ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026b ) , their capacity to reliably evaluate fine-grained physical aspects such as geometry and kinematics remains underexplored.
sents.zh: 尽管视觉语言模型已被越来越多地用作通用多模态任务和视频生成任务的自动评判器，但其可靠评估几何与运动学等细粒度物理属性的能力仍未得到充分探索。

sents.en: To investigate this, we implement a VLM-based evaluation pipeline alongside human raters and our proposed metrics, revealing that current VLMs struggle significantly with capturing spatial-temporal nuances in multi-view consistency and embodied physics.
sents.zh: 为研究这一问题，我们实现了一条基于视觉语言模型的评估流水线，并结合人类评分者与我们提出的指标，结果显示当前视觉语言模型在捕捉多视角一致性中的时空细微差异以及具身物理方面存在显著困难。

paragraphs.en: To comprehensively benchmark automated evaluation, we evaluate both closed-source and open-source Vision-Language Models, namely specifically Gemini 3.6 Flash, Qwen 3.6-Plus, Gemma 4 31B, and Qwen 3.6-35B-A3B, acting as automated judges via an OpenRouter -compatible API. To maintain consistency with human evaluation, the VLMs assess the same evaluation split detailed in Appendix D.1 using a matching protocol. For each evaluation variant (model × \times prompt type), every video is assessed in three independent turns to mitigate evaluation variance and potential bias. Table D2 lists the detailed configuration.

paragraphs.en: Table D3 reports the self-consistency, internal score standard deviation, and average processing time per 1 video second of VLM judges across evaluation turns, where evaluation scores are mapped to a discrete numerical scale (Bad: 1, Medium: 2, Good: 3).
paragraphs.zh: 表 D3 报告了 VLM 评审模型在各评估轮次中的自一致性、内部分数标准差以及每 1 视频秒的平均处理时间，其中评估分数被映射到离散数值量表（差：1，中：2，好：3）。

paragraphs.en: As reported in Table D3 , the embodied physics evaluation reveals that vanilla zero-shot models establish high scoring reliability. Qwen 3.6 Plus achieves the highest agreement rate of 90.3 percent and the lowest score standard deviation of 0.076 while requiring a latency of 4.396 seconds. Implementing chain-of-thought prompting severely harms this performance across all evaluated models. For instance, Qwen 3.6 35B experiences an agreement drop to 38.3 percent and a score standard deviation increase to 0.344 while its processing latency surges to 15.438 seconds. In contrast, our proposed KIVA metric eliminates these generative overheads entirely and achieves a superior processing latency of 0.289 seconds.
paragraphs.zh: 如表D3所示，具身物理评估表明，原生零样本模型具有很高的评分可靠性。 Qwen 3.6 Plus 达到了90.3%的最高一致率和0.076的最低评分标准差，同时延迟仅为4.396秒。 实施思维链提示会严重损害所有受评估模型的这一性能。 例如，Qwen 3.6 35B 的一致率下降至38.3%，评分标准差上升至0.344，同时其处理延迟飙升至15.438秒。 相比之下，我们提出的 KIVA 指标完全消除了这些生成式开销，并实现了0.289秒的更优处理延迟。

paragraphs.en: For the multi-view consistency evaluation presented in Table D3 , the increased task difficulty leads to lower overall agreement rates and higher score standard deviations for baseline models. Qwen 3.6 Plus again leads the vanilla zero-shot configurations by securing a 77.0 percent agreement rate and a score standard deviation of 0.191. Chain-of-thought prompting introduces substantial instability in this setting as well, where models like Qwen 3.6 Plus drop to an agreement rate of 33.7 percent alongside a score standard deviation of 0.591. Meanwhile, our proposed RIGIS metric maintains high computational efficiency by processing video inputs in 0.356 seconds, outperforming all baseline alternatives by a wide margin.
paragraphs.zh: 对于表D3中呈现的多视角一致性评估，任务难度的提升导致基线模型的整体一致率更低、得分标准差更高。 Qwen 3.6 Plus 在原始零样本配置中再次领先，取得了77.0%的一致率和0.191的得分标准差。 在该设置下，思维链提示同样引入了显著的不稳定性，例如 Qwen 3.6 Plus 等模型的一致率降至33.7%，得分标准差升至0.591。 与此同时，我们提出的 RIGIS 指标在0.356秒内处理视频输入，保持了较高的计算效率，以明显优势超越所有基线方案。

paragraphs.en: Fig. D3 plots KIVA’s score against the human label for each morphology. On all three the median score falls from Bad to Good. On Bimanual and Humanoid the levels are well separated and the calibrated cuts fall between them (Spearman ρ \rho of 0.78 and 0.60). On Single-Arm the medians still fall in order, but the three distributions overlap heavily and ρ \rho drops to 0.39.
paragraphs.zh: 图 D3 针对每种形态绘制了 KIVA 的分数与人工标注的对比。 在全部三种形态上，中位数分数都从 Bad 降到 Good。 在 Bimanual 和 Humanoid 上，各等级之间区分良好，校准后的切分点落在等级之间（Spearman ρ \rho 分别为 0.78 和 0.60）。 在 Single-Arm 上，中位数仍按顺序下降，但三个分布高度重叠，ρ \rho 降至 0.39。
