paragraphs.en: KIVA’s score is continuous, and a three-level verdict needs two cuts on it. With the default cuts (1.0 and 1.5 times the calibrated threshold), the overlap with human labels is 85.5%, 50.2% and 46.8% on Bimanual, Humanoid and Single-Arm. We refit the two cuts per morphology on nine labelled videos, three from each quality level, and score KIVA on the remaining videos. Averaged over 1000 random draws of the nine videos, the overlap on Humanoid rises from 50.2% to 59.1% and on Single-Arm from 46.8% to 59.1%, while Bimanual keeps its default cuts and moves from 85.5% to 84.2%. Macro overlap goes from 60.8% to 67.5% ( ± \pm 2.8 across draws) and micro overlap from 69.5% to 73.5% ( ± \pm 2.6). Calibration only moves the cuts, so it leaves Spearman’s ρ \rho unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: KIVA 的分数是连续的，三级判定需要在其上设定两个切分点。 使用默认切分点（校准阈值的 1.0 倍和 1.5 倍）时，与人工标注在 Bimanual、Humanoid 和 Single-Arm 上的重合率分别为 85.5%、50.2% 和 46.8%。 我们在九段有标注的视频上（每个质量等级各取三段）按形态重新拟合这两个切分点，并在其余视频上对 KIVA 进行评分。 对这九段视频的 1000 次随机抽取取平均后，Humanoid 上的重合率从 50.2% 升至 59.1%，Single-Arm 从 46.8% 升至 59.1%，而 Bimanual 保留默认切分点，从 85.5% 变为 84.2%。 宏观重合率从 60.8% 升至 67.5%（各次抽取间 ± \pm 2.8），微观重合率从 69.5% 升至 73.5%（± \pm 2.6）。 校准只是移动切分点，因此不会改变 Spearman ρ \rho。

paragraphs.en: Table D4 compares KIVA with the eight VLM configurations. On Bimanual, KIVA reaches ρ = 0.781 \rho=0.781 and 84.2% overlap, against at most 0.465 and 52.0% for a VLM. On Humanoid it has the highest Spearman (0.603 against 0.506) and matches the best VLM on overlap (59.1% against 58.8%). Over the three morphologies, KIVA reaches a macro ρ \rho of 0.591 and a macro overlap of 67.5%, against 0.525 and 61.2% for the best VLM; pooled over all segments, its overlap is 73.5% against 58.4%. Across the 1000 calibration draws, KIVA’s micro overlap is above that of Gemma 4 31B in 99.5% of draws. CoT prompting changes a VLM’s macro Spearman by less than 0.03.

paragraphs.en: To push the evaluation limits of vision-language models, we configure Gemma 4 31B with a structured few-shot prompting pipeline augmented by Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. The prompt establishes an expert roboticist persona, defines the 1 ​ – ​ 3 1\text{--}3 embodied physics scale, and includes annotated video exemplars with ground-truth human scores, enforcing sequential reasoning for contact stability and physical plausibility before scoring.
paragraphs.zh: 为了突破视觉-语言模型的评估极限，我们为 Gemma 4 31B 配置了一个结构化的少样本提示流水线，并辅以思维链（CoT）推理加以增强。 该提示建立了一个机器人专家的角色设定，定义了 1 ​ – ​ 3 1\text{--}3 的具身物理评分量表，并包含带有真值人类分数的标注视频示例，强制模型在打分前对接触稳定性与物理合理性进行逐步推理。

sents.zh: 为了突破视觉-语言模型的评估极限，我们为 Gemma 4 31B 配置了一个结构化的少样本提示流水线，并辅以思维链（CoT）推理加以增强。

sents.en: The prompt establishes an expert roboticist persona, defines the 1 ​ – ​ 3 1\text{--}3 embodied physics scale, and includes annotated video exemplars with ground-truth human scores, enforcing sequential reasoning for contact stability and physical plausibility before scoring.

paragraphs.en: To visually assess the agreement between RIGIS and human judgments, Fig. D4 illustrates the distribution of RIGIS scores across discrete human preference levels for three morphologies. Across all types, RIGIS demonstrates a clear, monotonic alignment with human ratings. As depicted by the box and strip plots, the median RIGIS score exhibits a distinct, step-wise upward trend from rating B ​ a ​ d Bad through G ​ o ​ o ​ d Good , accompanied by minimal interquartile range overlap between adjacent preference tiers. Specifically, Single-Arm systems present the most compact distributions and tightest point clustering. For higher-DoF configurations such as Bimanual and Humanoid platforms, the vertical margins between rating tiers remain sharp and well-separated. This distinct visual margin across all score levels confirms that RIGIS effectively evaluates multi-view consistency quality across diverse settings.
paragraphs.zh: 为了直观评估RIGIS与人类判断之间的一致性，图 D4展示了RIGIS分数在三种形态的离散人类偏好等级上的分布情况。 在所有类型中，RIGIS都表现出与人类评分清晰且单调的对齐关系。 如箱线图和散点图所示，RIGIS分数的中位数从 Bad 评级到 Good 评级呈现出明显的阶梯式上升趋势，同时相邻偏好层级之间的四分位距重叠极小。 具体而言，单臂系统呈现出最紧凑的分布和最紧密的点聚集。 对于双臂和人形平台等更高自由度的配置，评级层级之间的垂直边界依然清晰且分隔良好。 这种在所有分数层级上清晰可见的视觉边界证实了RIGIS能够有效评估多样场景下的多视角一致性质量。

sents.zh: 这种在所有分数层级上清晰可见的视觉边界证实了RIGIS能够有效评估多样场景下的多视角一致性质量。

paragraphs.en: As summarized in Table D5 , off-the-shelf VLMs struggle significantly to evaluate robotic video generation quality, primarily due to an inherent inability to comprehend cross-view geometry consistency. Under the Vanilla zero-shot setting, all baseline models exhibit weak alignment with human preferences, with the highest-performing VLM (Gemma 4 31B) reaching a mean Spearman ρ \rho of only 0.315 0.315 and a Rank Accuracy of 39.6 % 39.6\% . While prompting VLMs with CoT reasoning yields marginal gains for certain models, where Gemma 4 31B reaching ρ = 0.326 \rho=0.326 and Qwen 3.6 35B reaching RankAcc = 42.0 % \text{RankAcc}=42.0\% , their overall performance remains fundamentally inadequate. This confirms that general-purpose VLMs lack the necessary spatial and geometric grounding to detect multi-view physical and structural inconsistencies across synthesized camera angles.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 D5 所总结的那样，现成的 VLM 在评估机器人视频生成质量方面存在显著困难，其主要原因在于其天生无法理解跨视角几何一致性。 在 Vanilla 零样本设置下，所有基线模型与人类偏好的对齐程度都较弱，表现最好的 VLM（Gemma 4 31B）的平均 Spearman ρ \rho 仅为 0.315 0.315，Rank Accuracy 仅为 39.6 % 39.6\%。 虽然通过 CoT 推理对 VLM 进行提示能为某些模型带来边际提升，例如 Gemma 4 31B 达到 ρ = 0.326 \rho=0.326，Qwen 3.6 35B 达到 RankAcc = 42.0 % \text{RankAcc}=42.0\%，但其整体表现仍然根本性地不足。 这证实了通用 VLM 缺乏必要的空间和几何基础能力，无法检测跨合成相机视角的多视角物理与结构不一致性。

paragraphs.en: In contrast, RIGIS substantially outperforms all VLM judges across every morphology and metric. Overall, RIGIS achieves a mean Spearman ρ \rho of 0.749, representing a 138% relative improvement over the best VLM baseline, Gemma 4 31B CoT, which reaches 0.326 0.326 . Furthermore, RIGIS obtains a mean Rank Accuracy of 87.4 % 87.4\% , whereas the highest VLM result, achieved by Qwen 3.6 35B CoT, is only 42.0 % 42.0\% . Crucially, while VLMs exhibit severe performance instability across different robot configurations due to complex camera layouts and visual occlusions, as exemplified by Qwen 3.6 35B dropping to a Spearman ρ \rho of 0.024 0.024 on Single Arm, RIGIS maintains uniformly high alignment across all embodiments, consistently achieving a Spearman ρ \rho of at least 0.706 0.706 and a Rank Accuracy of at least 84.7 % 84.7\% .
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，RIGIS 在所有形态和所有指标上都显著优于所有 VLM 评判者。 总体而言，RIGIS 的平均 Spearman ρ \rho 达到 0.749，相比最佳 VLM 基线 Gemma 4 31B CoT（其得分为 0.326 0.326）实现了 138% 的相对提升。 此外，RIGIS 的平均排序准确率（Rank Accuracy）达到 87.4 % 87.4\%，而 VLM 的最高结果由 Qwen 3.6 35B CoT 取得，仅为 42.0 % 42.0\%。 至关重要的是，由于复杂的相机布局和视觉遮挡，VLM 在不同机器人配置上表现出严重的性能不稳定性，例如 Qwen 3.6 35B 在 Single Arm 上的 Spearman ρ \rho 降至 0.024 0.024，而 RIGIS 在所有具身形态上都保持 uniformly 高对齐度，Spearman ρ \rho 始终不低于 0.706 0.706，排序准确率始终不低于 84.7 % 84.7\%。

paragraphs.en: Fig. D5 showcases qualitative failure modes of VLM judges compared to human evaluations and RIGIS. The synchronized trajectories reveal that VLMs fail to properly leverage geometric and rig stability cues, leading to significant score discrepancies relative to ground-truth human ratings. These findings demonstrate that standard VLMs are unequipped to reason about cross-view geometric fidelity, reinforcing the necessity of RIGIS as a dedicated, geometry-aware surrogate metric for robotic video world model evaluation.

paragraphs.en: RoboWorM supports extension under a standardized protocol across three dimensions. New world models or acceleration methods integrate into the existing evaluation grid, producing metrics directly comparable to current results without re-establishing evaluation assets. Conversely, a new embodiment or dataset establishes a new table column, requiring explicit declaration of physical invariants like camera placement and motion criteria before evaluation. Fig. E1 illustrates these dimensions, and Appendix E.4 outlines the shared reporting checklist.
paragraphs.zh: RoboWorM 支持在标准化协议下沿三个维度进行扩展。 新的世界模型或加速方法可以集成到现有的评估网格中，直接生成与当前结果可比的指标，而无需重新建立评估资产。 反之，新的具身形态或数据集会新增一个表格列，需要在评估之前显式声明诸如相机摆放位置和运动判定标准等物理不变量。图 E1 展示了这些维度，附录 E.4 概述了共享的报告清单。

paragraphs.en: RoboWorM audits rollouts rather than architectures, requiring a minimal interface where a generator accepts a benchmark conditioning prefix and emits a frame-aligned RGB rollout at a declared frame rate. Because evaluation depends solely on this interface, structurally diverse models ranging from U-Nets to diffusion transformers are seamlessly compared. Consequently, models employing custom conditioning modalities remain fully admissible provided they satisfy the standard input and output specifications.
paragraphs.zh: RoboWorM 审计的是 rollout（轨迹回放）而非架构本身，它只要求一个最简接口：生成器接收基准条件化前缀，并以声明的帧率输出与帧对齐的 RGB rollout。 由于评估仅依赖该接口，从 U-Net 到扩散 Transformer 等结构各异的模型可以被无缝地加以比较。 因此，采用自定义条件化模态的模型只要满足标准的输入与输出规范，就完全可被纳入评估。

paragraphs.en: RoboWorM releases three conditioning signals per episode, allowing models to use any subset:
paragraphs.zh: RoboWorM 每个回合（episode）释放三个调节信号，允许模型使用其中任意子集：

paragraphs.en: Observation prefix: Contains conditioning frames at the declared resolution and frame rate.
paragraphs.zh: 观察前缀：包含以所声明的分辨率和帧率提供的条件帧。

paragraphs.en: Instruction string: Verbatim text from the source corpus, scored in the Text Alignment column where text-ignoring models receive a None score rather than zero.
paragraphs.zh: Instruction string：来自源语料的逐字文本，在「文本对齐」列中进行评分，其中忽略文本的模型得分为 None 而非零分。

paragraphs.en: Proprioception: Frame-aligned state and action vectors with synchronized indices. Action dimensionality is model-defined using released vectors truncated to standard 14 14 -D, 8 8 -D, or 7 7 -D interfaces, with custom truncation explicitly declared.
paragraphs.zh: 本体感觉：与帧对齐的状态和动作向量，索引保持同步。 动作维度由模型定义，使用发布的向量并截断到标准的 14 14 维、8 8 维或 7 7 维接口，自定义截断需显式声明。

paragraphs.en: Two strict constraints apply: normalization must use fixed per-dimension statistics shared within each table cell, and conditioning prefixes must remain identical across compared methods to ensure valid paired attribution.
paragraphs.zh: 适用两个严格的约束条件：归一化必须使用在每个表格单元格内共享的固定逐维统计量，且条件化前缀在所有被比较的方法中必须保持一致，以确保有效的成对归因。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating a released checkpoint zero-shot measures domain shift rather than acceleration. In-domain fine-tuning significantly improves performance, moving PSNR by + 5.94 +5.94 and + 6.76 +6.76 dB on Ctrl-World configurations and by + 4.09 +4.09 and + 4.14 +4.14 dB on DreamGen (see Appendix C.1 ), whereas un-finetuned failures cause severe scene collapse (see Fig. C1 ). Because dense rollouts serve as the normalization reference for all acceleration results, an un-finetuned baseline invalidates retention scores. Consequently, new models must be fine-tuned on the released training corpus using the pipeline in Appendix A.2 and report dense quality prior to acceleration. Unmatched fine-tuning recipes are fully permissible since the benchmark evaluates accelerators relative to the generator input.
paragraphs.zh: 对已发布检查点进行零样本评估衡量的是域偏移，而非加速效果。 域内微调能显著提升性能，在 Ctrl-World 配置上使 PSNR 分别提升 + 5.94 +5.94 和 + 6.76 +6.76 dB，在 DreamGen 上分别提升 + 4.09 +4.09 和 + 4.14 +4.14 dB（见附录 C.1），而未微调的失败会导致严重的场景崩塌（见图 C1）。 由于密集 rollout 是所有加速结果的归一化基准，未微调的基线会使保持率分数失效。 因此，新模型必须使用附录 A.2 中的流程在已发布的训练语料上进行微调，并在加速之前报告密集质量。 微调配方不必一致是完全允许的，因为该基准是相对于生成器输入来评估加速器的。

paragraphs.en: New models integrate by implementing the released three-stage pipeline consisting of data preparation, inference rollout, and execution wrappers.
paragraphs.zh: 新模型通过实现已发布的三阶段流水线来完成集成，该流水线包括数据准备、推理回滚（inference rollout）和执行包装器（execution wrappers）。

paragraphs.en: Match rollout lengths to ground-truth episodes rather than fixed horizons to capture long-horizon behavior (Sec. 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 将 rollout 长度与真实轨迹（ground-truth episodes）相匹配，而非使用固定的时间跨度，以捕捉长时程行为（第 4.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Discover episodes dynamically from annotation directories.
paragraphs.zh: 从标注目录中动态发现片段。

paragraphs.en: Make execution passes resumable by skipping existing outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 让执行过程可通过跳过已存在的输出实现可恢复。

paragraphs.en: Mirror dense rollout subtrees with accelerated variants to enable straightforward paired comparisons keyed on episode paths.
paragraphs.zh: 将密集的回滚子树与加速变体进行镜像，以便能够基于情节路径进行直接的成对比较。

paragraphs.en: Following rollout generation, evaluation proceeds uniformly without per-model customization by mapping clips to the standard analysis grid (Appendix C ): removing conditioning frames, striding to approximately 5 5 fps, cropping the target view, and resampling to 256 × 192 256\times 192 before computing metrics (Sec B ). This standardization ensures models generating at different native frame rates face no disadvantage, provided the declared rate is accurate. Furthermore, reference-free columns and physical audits require no dense counterpart, allowing new models to be evaluated on KIVA, RIGIS, and reference-free metrics independently of acceleration. Reference-based columns evaluate accelerators relative to the model’s own dense rollout, rendering them inapplicable to standalone dense entrants. Finally, Visual Integrity remains barred from model ranking while serving in acceleration comparisons, and Text Alignment supports ranking claims only as a paired delta (Appendix B.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 rollout 生成之后，评估以统一方式进行，无需针对各模型定制：将片段映射到标准分析网格（附录 C），即移除条件帧、以约 5 5 fps 步进采样、裁剪目标视角，并在计算指标（Sec B）前重采样至 256 × 192 256\times 192。 这种标准化确保以不同原生帧率生成的模型不会处于劣势，前提是所声明的帧率准确无误。 此外，无参考指标列和物理审计不需要稠密对应版本，因此新模型可以在 KIVA、RIGIS 和无参考指标上独立于加速进行评估。 基于参考的指标列将加速器相对于模型自身的稠密 rollout 进行评估，因此不适用于独立的稠密模型参赛者。 最后，视觉完整性在参与加速比较时仍不得用于模型排名，而文本对齐仅以成对差值的形式支持排名结论（附录 B.3）。

paragraphs.en: New models need not cover the entire grid, as demonstrated by existing configurations spanning subsets. However, any covered cell must be evaluated completely across both task-dynamics regimes, all source cameras, and every curated episode, since partial evaluations compromise comparability. Furthermore, single-view FVD is referenced to each configuration’s own ground truth rather than a shared pool, meaning new single-view models must report FVD against their own baseline and cannot be FVD-ranked against other single-view rows. Speedup measurements and physical audits carry no such restriction.
paragraphs.zh: 新模型无需覆盖整个网格，现有配置仅覆盖子集便已证明了这一点。 然而，任何被覆盖的单元格都必须在两种任务动态机制、所有源摄像头以及每个精选片段上进行完整评估，因为部分评估会损害可比性。 此外，单视角 FVD 是以每个配置自身的真实数据为参照，而非共享池，这意味着新的单视角模型必须针对其自身基线报告 FVD，且无法与其他单视角行进行 FVD 排名比较。 加速比测量与物理审计则不受此类限制。

sents.en: New models need not cover the entire grid, as demonstrated by existing configurations spanning subsets.
sents.zh: 新模型无需覆盖整个网格，现有配置仅覆盖子集便已证明了这一点。

sents.en: However, any covered cell must be evaluated completely across both task-dynamics regimes, all source cameras, and every curated episode, since partial evaluations compromise comparability.
sents.zh: 然而，任何被覆盖的单元格都必须在两种任务动态机制、所有源摄像头以及每个精选片段上进行完整评估，因为部分评估会损害可比性。

sents.en: Furthermore, single-view FVD is referenced to each configuration’s own ground truth rather than a shared pool, meaning new single-view models must report FVD against their own baseline and cannot be FVD-ranked against other single-view rows.
sents.zh: 此外，单视角 FVD 是以每个配置自身的真实数据为参照，而非共享池，这意味着新的单视角模型必须针对其自身基线报告 FVD，且无法与其他单视角行进行 FVD 排名比较。

sents.en: Speedup measurements and physical audits carry no such restriction.
sents.zh: 加速比测量与物理审计则不受此类限制。

paragraphs.en: Adding a world model or accelerator consumes benchmark invariants, whereas adding an embodiment supplies them. Physical audits are not generic appearance measures: KIVA verifies link length consistency and plausible jerk budgets for the embodiment, while RIGIS checks whether simultaneous multi-view feeds are consistent with a single camera rig geometry. Both audits require explicit domain-specific metadata including link connectivity, normal morphology motion bounds, and camera extrinsics. Because scoring relies on this closed-world assumption, registering a new embodiment requires declaring these invariants rather than inferring them at evaluation time. Consequently, embodiment extension includes a dedicated audit instantiation stage following preparation and fine-tuning, as shown in Fig. E1 -b.
paragraphs.zh: 增加世界模型或加速器会消耗基准不变量，而增加具身则会提供这些不变量。 物理审计并非泛泛的外观度量：KIVA 验证具身的连杆长度一致性与合理的加加速度预算，而 RIGIS 检查同时传输的多视角画面是否与单一相机支架几何结构一致。 两项审计都需要显式的领域特定元数据，包括连杆连接关系、正常形态的运动边界以及相机外参。 由于评分依赖这一封闭世界假设，注册新的具身需要显式声明这些不变量，而不是在评估时推断它们。 因此，如图 E1-b 所示，具身扩展在准备和微调之后包含一个专门的审计实例化阶段。

sents.en: Consequently, embodiment extension includes a dedicated audit instantiation stage following preparation and fine-tuning, as shown in Fig. E1 -b.

paragraphs.en: RoboWorM collects no new data, meaning a new domain integrates using the standard ingestion pipeline detailed in Appendix A.1 .
paragraphs.zh: RoboWorM 不收集任何新数据，这意味着新领域可以通过附录 A.1 中详述的标准数据接入流程进行整合。

paragraphs.en: Ensure the source corpus satisfies these requirements:
paragraphs.zh: 请确保源语料库满足以下要求：

paragraphs.en: Provide synchronized RGB video across all rig cameras with a declared frame rate and resolution, time-aligned per-frame proprioception, and a verbatim instruction string per episode.
paragraphs.zh: 为所有采集架摄像机提供同步的 RGB 视频，并声明帧率与分辨率，提供逐帧时间对齐的本体感知数据，以及每条回合的逐字指令字符串。

paragraphs.en: Maintain consistent camera counts and stability within each evaluation cell.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个评估单元内保持一致的摄像机数量和稳定性。

paragraphs.en: Ensure episode lengths accommodate generator training windows, such as the 93 93 -frame requirement for DreamGen.
paragraphs.zh: 确保片段长度能够适应生成器的训练窗口，例如 DreamGen 所要求的 93 93 帧长度。

paragraphs.en: Confirm corpora are redistributable or reproducibly obtainable, applying no success or minimum-length filters to allow episodes to span from 4 4 to 3,000 3{,}000 frames.
paragraphs.zh: 确认语料库可再分发或可复现地获取，不应用任何成功或最短长度过滤器，以允许情节（episode）的长度从 4 4 到 3,000 3{,}000 帧不等。

paragraphs.en: Assign task taxonomies and dynamics regimes strictly before generating rollouts. Parse task instruction clauses and map leading verbs to canonical manipulation primitives, ensuring unmatched verbs are explicitly reported rather than silently bucketed across the 507 507 instructions and 14 14 primitives detailed in Appendix A.3 . Classify tasks as non-Markovian when correct continuation requires historical context invisible in the current frame (Appendix A.1 ). Assign this regime label from the task definition prior to rollout generation to prevent model behavior from biasing the classification and to preserve axis integrity, as these regimes dictate rollout depth (Appendix C.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在生成 rollout 之前严格分配任务分类与动态机制。 解析任务指令子句，并将开头的动词映射到规范的操作基元，确保未匹配的动词被显式报告，而不是被默默归入附录 A.3 中详述的 507 507 条指令和 14 14 个基元。 当正确的后续动作需要当前帧中不可见的历史上下文时，将该任务分类为非马尔可夫任务（附录 A.1）。 在生成 rollout 之前根据任务定义分配此机制标签，以防模型行为使分类产生偏差并保持该轴的完整性，因为这些机制决定了 rollout 的深度（附录 C.2）。

sents.en: Assign task taxonomies and dynamics regimes strictly before generating rollouts.
sents.zh: 在生成 rollout 之前严格分配任务分类与动态机制。

sents.en: Parse task instruction clauses and map leading verbs to canonical manipulation primitives, ensuring unmatched verbs are explicitly reported rather than silently bucketed across the 507 507 instructions and 14 14 primitives detailed in Appendix A.3 .
sents.zh: 解析任务指令子句，并将开头的动词映射到规范的操作基元，确保未匹配的动词被显式报告，而不是被默默归入附录 A.3 中详述的 507 507 条指令和 14 14 个基元。

sents.zh: 当正确的后续动作需要当前帧中不可见的历史上下文时，将该任务分类为非马尔可夫任务（附录 A.1）。

sents.en: Assign this regime label from the task definition prior to rollout generation to prevent model behavior from biasing the classification and to preserve axis integrity, as these regimes dictate rollout depth (Appendix C.2 ).
sents.zh: 在生成 rollout 之前根据任务定义分配此机制标签，以防模型行为使分类产生偏差并保持该轴的完整性，因为这些机制决定了 rollout 的深度（附录 C.2）。

paragraphs.en: While video geometry models such as VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026 ) enable camera pose estimation, allowing RIGIS to operate on generated videos without rigid camera assumptions, providing explicit camera parameters is strongly recommended. Supplying these ground-truth calibration profiles establishes an optimal reference for multi-view consistency evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管诸如 VGGT-Ω（Wang et al., 2026）等视频几何模型能够进行相机位姿估计，使 RIGIS 可以在生成的视频上运行而不依赖刚性的相机假设，但仍强烈建议提供显式的相机参数。 提供这些真实标定参数能够为多视角一致性评估建立最优参考基准。

sents.en: While video geometry models such as VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026 ) enable camera pose estimation, allowing RIGIS to operate on generated videos without rigid camera assumptions, providing explicit camera parameters is strongly recommended.
sents.zh: 尽管诸如 VGGT-Ω（Wang et al., 2026）等视频几何模型能够进行相机位姿估计，使 RIGIS 可以在生成的视频上运行而不依赖刚性的相机假设，但仍强烈建议提供显式的相机参数。

sents.en: Supplying these ground-truth calibration profiles establishes an optimal reference for multi-view consistency evaluation.
sents.zh: 提供这些真实标定参数能够为多视角一致性评估建立最优参考基准。

paragraphs.en: Follow the preparation in Appendix A.2 while retaining four inherited decisions:
paragraphs.zh: 请遵循附录 A.2 中的准备工作，同时保留四个继承的决策：

paragraphs.en: Resize frames to native training resolutions via bilinear resampling without letterboxing or aspect ratio preservation, restricting cross-cell metric comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 通过双线性重采样将帧调整为原生训练分辨率，不使用留黑边（letterboxing）或保持宽高比，这限制了跨单元的指标比较。

paragraphs.en: Apply integer-striding temporal resampling to match model training rates, measuring realized rates directly on generated clips.
paragraphs.zh: 对生成片段直接测量实际帧率，应用整数步长时间重采样以匹配模型训练速率。

paragraphs.en: Compose multi-view settings into a single canvas where unused slots are filled with black frames, marked inactive in the prompt, and excluded from all metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 将多视图设置组合到单一画布中，其中未使用的槽位以黑色帧填充，在提示词中标记为未激活，并从所有指标中排除。

paragraphs.en: Compute proprioception dimensions and per-dimension percentile normalization from prepared episodes to establish fixed cell-wide normalization parameters, and drop episodes missing required streams rather than padding them.
paragraphs.zh: 基于准备好的片段（episodes）计算本体感觉维度及逐维百分位归一化，以建立固定的全单元宽度归一化参数，并丢弃缺少所需数据流的片段，而不是对其进行填充。

paragraphs.en: Never reuse another morphology’s thresholds, as doing so misattributes structural differences as hallucination rates. Calibrate KIVA violation thresholds specifically for the new source corpus using clip-level band cuts of 1.00 1.00 and 1.50 1.50 derived from the 95 95 th percentile of real data rather than human-fitted values (Appendix B.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 切勿复用其他形态学的阈值，否则会将结构性差异误判为幻觉率。 应针对新源语料库专门校准 KIVA 违规阈值，使用基于真实数据第 95 95 百分位数而非人工拟合值的片段级区间切分点 1.00 1.00 和 1.50 1.50（参见附录 B.1）。

sents.en: Never reuse another morphology’s thresholds, as doing so misattributes structural differences as hallucination rates.
sents.zh: 切勿复用其他形态学的阈值，否则会将结构性差异误判为幻觉率。

sents.en: Calibrate KIVA violation thresholds specifically for the new source corpus using clip-level band cuts of 1.00 1.00 and 1.50 1.50 derived from the 95 95 th percentile of real data rather than human-fitted values (Appendix B.1 ).
sents.zh: 应针对新源语料库专门校准 KIVA 违规阈值，使用基于真实数据第 95 95 百分位数而非人工拟合值的片段级区间切分点 1.00 1.00 和 1.50 1.50（参见附录 B.1）。

paragraphs.en: Perform dedicated real-segment calibration passes before scoring generated segments.
paragraphs.zh: 在为生成的分段评分之前，先执行专门的真实验证分段校准流程。

paragraphs.en: Implement a morphology-specific keypoint reader for rigidity and jerk computations (Appendix B.1 ), as explicitly named in Fig. E1 -b.
paragraphs.zh: 实现一个针对刚度和加加速度计算的特定形态关键点读取器（附录 B.1），如 Fig. E1 -b 中明确命名的那样。

paragraphs.en: Provide co-located real-video anchors for RIGIS and a real video pool keyed by embodiment, camera, and regime for FVD, validated via split-half exchangeability checks (Appendix B.3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为 RIGIS 提供同地定位的真实视频锚点，并提供按具身、相机和模态索引的真实视频池用于 FVD，通过对半可交换性检验进行验证（附录 B.3.3）。

paragraphs.en: Avoid human-label fitting; optimizing thresholds for raw agreement severely distorts class balance, reducing minority class emissions from 18.6 % 18.6\% to 3.0 % 3.0\% and yielding a worse detector despite superficially improved scores.
paragraphs.zh: 避免拟合人工标注；针对原始一致性优化阈值会严重扭曲类别平衡，使少数类别的输出比例从 18.6 % 18.6\% 降至 3.0 % 3.0\%，尽管分数表面上有所提升，却产生了更差的检测器。

paragraphs.en: Recognize that the minimal fine-tuning stage designated in Fig. E1 -b is relative. Adapting the three supported backbones to a new domain is inexpensive only because training recipes are publicly released, use full fine-tunes without secondary adapters, and share the preparation pipeline. True effort concentrates in registration and calibration rather than training, as the keypoint reader, real-segment thresholds, mount declarations, and FVD pool must be established before scoring any generated clip.
paragraphs.zh: 需要认识到，图 E1-b 中所标注的最小微调阶段是相对而言的。 将三个受支持的骨干网络适配到新领域之所以成本低廉，只是因为训练方案已公开发布，使用完整微调而无需次要适配器，并且共享同一套准备流程。 真正的工作量集中在注册与校准而非训练上，因为在给任何生成的片段评分之前，必须先建立关键点读取器、真实片段阈值、安装声明以及 FVD 池。

sents.en: Recognize that the minimal fine-tuning stage designated in Fig. E1 -b is relative.
sents.zh: 需要认识到，图 E1-b 中所标注的最小微调阶段是相对而言的。

sents.en: Adapting the three supported backbones to a new domain is inexpensive only because training recipes are publicly released, use full fine-tunes without secondary adapters, and share the preparation pipeline.
sents.zh: 将三个受支持的骨干网络适配到新领域之所以成本低廉，只是因为训练方案已公开发布，使用完整微调而无需次要适配器，并且共享同一套准备流程。

sents.en: True effort concentrates in registration and calibration rather than training, as the keypoint reader, real-segment thresholds, mount declarations, and FVD pool must be established before scoring any generated clip.
sents.zh: 真正的工作量集中在注册与校准而非训练上，因为在给任何生成的片段评分之前，必须先建立关键点读取器、真实片段阈值、安装声明以及 FVD 池。

paragraphs.en: This is the cheapest extension because it reuses existing episodes, conditioning, and checkpoints, making acceleration training-free and focused entirely on inference. Each method follows a simple pattern: a configuration module with an argument group and a builder that creates the runtime setup. Inference scripts forward these arguments, so methods are enabled via flags without modifying model code or forking architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 这是最廉价的扩展方式，因为它复用了现有的片段、条件设置和检查点，使加速无需训练，完全专注于推理。 每种方法都遵循一个简单的模式：一个带有参数组的配置模块，以及一个创建运行时设置的构建器。 推理脚本会转发这些参数，因此各种方法可以通过标志位启用，无需修改模型代码或派生架构。

sents.en: This is the cheapest extension because it reuses existing episodes, conditioning, and checkpoints, making acceleration training-free and focused entirely on inference.
sents.zh: 这是最廉价的扩展方式，因为它复用了现有的片段、条件设置和检查点，使加速无需训练，完全专注于推理。

sents.en: Each method follows a simple pattern: a configuration module with an argument group and a builder that creates the runtime setup.
sents.zh: 每种方法都遵循一个简单的模式：一个带有参数组的配置模块，以及一个创建运行时设置的构建器。

sents.en: Inference scripts forward these arguments, so methods are enabled via flags without modifying model code or forking architectures.
sents.zh: 推理脚本会转发这些参数，因此各种方法可以通过标志位启用，无需修改模型代码或派生架构。

paragraphs.en: Always compute speedups against a dense baseline re-run inside the same cell, on identical episodes, and under the same configuration. Never use stored constants or pre-computed summaries for the 1.00 × 1.00\times reference.
paragraphs.zh: 始终以在同一单元格内重新运行的稠密基线作为对照来计算加速比，且必须在完全相同的回合和相同的配置下进行。 绝不要使用存储的常量或预先计算的摘要来作为 1.00 × 1.00\times 的参考值。

sents.en: Always compute speedups against a dense baseline re-run inside the same cell, on identical episodes, and under the same configuration.
sents.zh: 始终以在同一单元格内重新运行的稠密基线作为对照来计算加速比，且必须在完全相同的回合和相同的配置下进行。

sents.en: Never use stored constants or pre-computed summaries for the 1.00 × 1.00\times reference.
sents.zh: 绝不要使用存储的常量或预先计算的摘要来作为 1.00 × 1.00\times 的参考值。

paragraphs.en: Execute the identical command line with the method flags disabled using the built-in toggle switch.
paragraphs.zh: 使用内置切换开关，在禁用方法标志的情况下执行完全相同的命令行。

paragraphs.en: Verify that control and candidate runs differ only by the intervention to eliminate configuration drift and sampling noise.
paragraphs.zh: 请验证对照组运行与候选组运行仅因干预措施而存在差异，以消除配置漂移和采样噪声。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark methods at their performance knee on each cell rather than using default author settings. The knee is the most aggressive setting where quality remains indistinguishable from the cell dense rollout.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试方法在每个单元格上采用其性能拐点设置，而不是使用作者默认设置。 拐点是最激进但仍与单元格稠密推出质量无法区分的设置。

sents.en: Benchmark methods at their performance knee on each cell rather than using default author settings.
sents.zh: 基准测试方法在每个单元格上采用其性能拐点设置，而不是使用作者默认设置。

sents.en: The knee is the most aggressive setting where quality remains indistinguishable from the cell dense rollout.
sents.zh: 拐点是最激进但仍与单元格稠密推出质量无法区分的设置。

paragraphs.en: Vary the primary quality-speed knob while holding warm-up parameters constant.
paragraphs.zh: 在保持预热参数不变的情况下，调整质量-速度这一主要旋钮。

paragraphs.en: Score each point using PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS against the dense rollout of the same episode.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 针对同一回合的密集 rollout 对每个点进行评分。

paragraphs.en: Inspect the final frame manually to detect multi-view smearing, compression artifacts, and metric collapse points where washed-out frames artificially outscore structurally incorrect high-frequency details.
paragraphs.zh: 手动检查最后一帧，以检测多视角拖影、压缩伪影以及指标崩塌点——在这些点上，画面泛白的帧会人为地获得高于结构性错误的高频细节的分数。

paragraphs.en: Publish the complete curve and configurations that caused visible degradation alongside the final shipped configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 连同最终发布的配置，一并公开导致可见性能退化的完整曲线和各项配置。

paragraphs.en: Write all sweep outputs to scratch directories rather than the canonical rollout tree to prevent mixing tuning artifacts with released rollouts, and record the shipped configuration per cell rather than per method.
paragraphs.zh: 将所有扫掠输出写入临时目录而非正式发布目录，以避免将调优产物与已发布的 rollout 混在一起，并按单元格而非按方法记录所交付的配置。

paragraphs.en: Never tune a method once and transfer the settings across settings. Backbone dispersion causes a median absolute disagreement of 0.102 0.102 in aggregate retention across accelerator-cell pairs, with nearly half of the pairs falling on opposite sides of the quality threshold ( Q = 0.95 Q=0.95 ).
paragraphs.zh: 切勿对某个方法只调参一次，就将这些设置迁移到其他设置中。 骨干网络的分散性导致不同加速器单元组合之间在总体保留率上的中位数绝对分歧为 0.102，近半数的组合落在质量阈值（Q=0.95）的相反两侧。

sents.en: Never tune a method once and transfer the settings across settings.
sents.zh: 切勿对某个方法只调参一次，就将这些设置迁移到其他设置中。

sents.en: Backbone dispersion causes a median absolute disagreement of 0.102 0.102 in aggregate retention across accelerator-cell pairs, with nearly half of the pairs falling on opposite sides of the quality threshold ( Q = 0.95 Q=0.95 ).
sents.zh: 骨干网络的分散性导致不同加速器单元组合之间在总体保留率上的中位数绝对分歧为 0.102，近半数的组合落在质量阈值（Q=0.95）的相反两侧。

paragraphs.en: Perform tuning independently for every cell because optimal operating points depend entirely on backbone runtime composition and sequence length.
paragraphs.zh: 请对每个单元格独立进行调优，因为最优运行点完全取决于骨干网络运行时的组成方式以及序列长度。

paragraphs.en: Avoid global defaults, which lead to mis-tuned configurations that falsely classify methods as lossless on one backbone while causing visible damage on another (see Appendix C.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 避免使用全局默认设置，因为它们会导致调优不当的配置，从而在某个主干网络上将某方法误判为无损，而在另一个主干网络上却造成明显的损害（见附录 C.2）。

paragraphs.en: Measure all speedups strictly sequentially on a single idle A100-SXM4-80GB GPU per run, with context parallelism disabled.
paragraphs.zh: 每次运行均严格在单张空闲的 A100-SXM4-80GB GPU 上按顺序测量所有加速比，并禁用上下文并行。

paragraphs.en: Refuse execution on any busy GPU card to prevent co-tenancy overheads from inflating generation times by 15 % 15\% to 20 % 20\% .
paragraphs.zh: 拒绝在任何繁忙的 GPU 卡上执行，以防止共驻开销使生成时间增加 15%15\% 到 20%20\%。

paragraphs.en: Read generation times exclusively from each family’s authoritative log line rather than process wall clock, avoiding distortions from model loading, video muxing, or metric computations.
paragraphs.zh: 生成时间的读取应完全来自每个系列（family）的权威日志行，而不是进程墙钟时间，以避免模型加载、视频封装或指标计算造成的偏差。

paragraphs.en: Sample each cell using episodes from both regimes to account for length-dependent savings.
paragraphs.zh: 使用来自两种情形的回合对每个单元格进行采样，以考虑与长度相关的节省。

paragraphs.en: Report initial segment performance separately from the steady-state ratio to capture one-off warm-up costs, such as attention profiling or k k -means initialization, preventing distortions in the baseline comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 将初始片段的性能与稳态比率分开报告，以捕捉一次性预热成本（例如注意力剖析或 k k-均值初始化），避免对基线比较造成失真。

paragraphs.en: Report every quality claim as a paired delta representing the accelerated clip minus its own dense clip on the same episode, view, and matched frame grid.
paragraphs.zh: 将每个质量声明报告为一个成对差值，表示加速片段减去其在同一剧集、同一视角和匹配帧网格上的自身稠密片段。

paragraphs.en: Provide the measured speedup alongside Δ \Delta KIVA (in percentage points of invalid segments), Δ \Delta RIGIS (for multi-view settings), and paired deltas for the four reference-free columns.
paragraphs.zh: 请提供测得的加速比，同时给出 Δ \Delta KIVA（以无效段百分点计）、Δ \Delta RIGIS（用于多视角设置），以及四个无参考列的成对差值。

paragraphs.en: Include the valid sample size ( n n ), exclusion rate, and ensure the claim gate from Appendix E.4 is applied.
paragraphs.zh: 请包含有效样本量（ n n ）、排除率，并确保应用了附录 E.4 中的声明门控（claim gate）。

paragraphs.en: Use the aggregate retention Q Q defined in Appendix C.2 solely as a ranking statistic, avoiding it for effect sizes due to its compression factor of 2.8 2.8 to 3.2 3.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 仅将附录 C.2 中定义的聚合保留量 Q Q 用作排序统计量，避免将其用于效应量估计，因为其存在 2.8 2.8 至 3.2 3.2 的压缩因子。

paragraphs.en: Recognize that audit improvements under acceleration do not indicate superior rollouts, and account for baseline divergence where high dense hallucination rates (e.g., 59.4 % 59.4\% KIVA versus a 10.1 % 10.1\% real-video baseline) constrain the interpretation of accelerated values.
paragraphs.zh: 需要认识到，加速条件下的审计改进并不代表更优的 rollout，同时应考虑基线差异——高密集幻觉率（例如 59.4 % 59.4\% 的 KIVA 对比 10.1 % 10.1\% 的真实视频基线）会限制对加速数值的解读。

paragraphs.en: Report all negative results, including methods that fail to accelerate and fall below 1 × 1\times speed, rather than omitting them or replacing them with stronger alternatives from the same family.
paragraphs.zh: 报告所有负面结果，包括未能加速且低于 1 × 1\times 速度的方法，而不是将其省略或用同一家族中更强的替代方法来替换它们。

paragraphs.en: Retain negative rows (such as sparse attention on the Ctrl-World U-Net or slower-than-dense configurations on DreamDojo) to preserve full benchmark information.
paragraphs.zh: 保留负向行（例如 Ctrl-World U-Net 上的稀疏注意力，或 DreamDojo 上慢于稠密配置的结果），以保留完整的基准测试信息。

paragraphs.en: Distinguish clearly between measured failures and unmeasured configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 明确区分已测量的失败与未测量的配置。

paragraphs.en: Never interpolate missing cell values from neighboring configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 切勿从相邻配置中插值缺失的单元格值。

paragraphs.en: Apply the claim gate to convert any measurement into a formal statement across all extension paths. Aggregate rollout values for a cell as a median with a 95 % 95\% bootstrap confidence interval within a single stratum (model, embodiment, camera mount, and regime), reporting both the valid sample size n n and the exclusion rate.
paragraphs.zh: 将声明门控应用于所有扩展路径，把任何测量结果转换为正式陈述。 在单一分层（模型、实体形态、相机安装方式与运行机制）内，将某个单元的发布值聚合为中位数，并附带 95% 的自助法置信区间，同时报告有效样本量 n 与排除率。

sents.en: Apply the claim gate to convert any measurement into a formal statement across all extension paths.
sents.zh: 将声明门控应用于所有扩展路径，把任何测量结果转换为正式陈述。

sents.en: Aggregate rollout values for a cell as a median with a 95 % 95\% bootstrap confidence interval within a single stratum (model, embodiment, camera mount, and regime), reporting both the valid sample size n n and the exclusion rate.
sents.zh: 在单一分层（模型、实体形态、相机安装方式与运行机制）内，将某个单元的发布值聚合为中位数，并附带 95% 的自助法置信区间，同时报告有效样本量 n 与排除率。

paragraphs.en: Promote a difference to a valid claim only when the confidence interval strictly excludes zero, the Wilcoxon signed-rank test yields p < 0.05 p<0.05 , and n ≥ 8 n\geq 8 .
paragraphs.zh: 仅当置信区间严格排除零、Wilcoxon 符号秩检验得到 p < 0.05 p<0.05，且 n ≥ 8 n\geq 8 时，才将差异提升为有效结论。

paragraphs.en: Report any cell with n < 8 n<8 as untested rather than showing no effect.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 n < 8 n<8 的单元格，报告为未测试，而不是显示无影响。

paragraphs.en: Ensure paired deltas originate from the exact same measurement rather than merely the same episode, requiring identical source frame rates, effective frame rates, and lengths matching within 10 % 10\% .
paragraphs.zh: 请确保成对差值来自完全相同的测量，而不仅仅是同一回合，要求源帧率、有效帧率完全相同，且长度差异在 10 % 10\% 以内。

paragraphs.en: This strict gate is mandatory; for instance, it successfully rejected 226 226 out of 1,836 1{,}836 acceleration pairs, including an entire cell where differing frame rates and lengths between dense and accelerated rollouts manufactured spurious continuity gains (Sec. 4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这道严格的关卡是强制性的；例如，它成功拒绝了 1,836 个加速对中的 226 个，其中包括某个完整的单元——在该单元中，密集 rollout 与加速 rollout 之间不同的帧率和长度制造出了虚假的连续性提升（见第 4.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: A submission to RoboWorM must include the items listed below, grouped by extension path with a shared block applying to all submissions.
paragraphs.zh: 提交到 RoboWorM 的内容必须包括以下各项，按扩展路径分组，并包含一个适用于所有提交的共享代码块。

paragraphs.en: Shared. (i) Covered grid settings, including task-dynamics regimes, all rig cameras, and episode counts compared against curated cell totals. (ii) Unchanged analysis grid confirmation (conditioning frames dropped, stride adjusted to ≈ 5 \approx\!5 fps, requested view cropped, resampled to 256 × 192 256\times 192 , and clips under three surviving frames excluded from scoring). (iii) Per-cell median, 95 % 95\% bootstrap confidence interval, valid n n , and exclusion rate for every reported column, ensuring the claim gate is applied and untested settings are explicitly labeled. (iv) Unmeasurable quantities recorded as None rather than 0 0 to prevent conflating missing data with zero motion. (v) Strict adherence to per-column restrictions (no model ranking on Visual Integrity, no unpaired Text Alignment median, and no per-cell claims on FVD where effective n = 1 n=1 ). (vi) Clear identification of single-sample values versus means.
paragraphs.zh: 共享。 (i) 覆盖网格设置，包括任务动态区间、所有装备摄像机以及与人工整理的单元格总数进行对比的回合数。 (ii) 确认分析网格保持不变（丢弃条件帧，步长调整为约 5 \approx\!5 fps，对请求的视图进行裁剪并重采样至 256 × 192 256\times 192，且少于三帧存续帧的片段被排除在评分之外）。 (iii) 每个报告列的逐单元格中位数、95 % 95\% 自举置信区间、有效 n n 以及排除率，确保应用论断门槛，并对未经检验的设置予以明确标注。 (iv) 将不可测量的量记录为 None 而非 0 0，以防止将缺失数据与零运动混为一谈。 (v) 严格遵守逐列限制（不对 Visual Integrity 进行模型排名，不提供非配对的 Text Alignment 中位数，且在有效 n = 1 n=1 的 FVD 上不做逐单元格论断）。 (vi) 清晰区分单样本值与均值。

paragraphs.en: Preserve the strict separation between the two reporting surfaces utilized throughout this benchmark. Absolute per-configuration medians describe a configuration against its own dense baseline and must never be compared vertically down a column across different configurations. Paired deltas carry no absolute level and serve as the exclusive surface for ranking acceleration methods. Maintaining both surfaces requires no extra scoring effort, as pairing is performed via a simple join and subtraction at table time, ensuring new methods remain immediately comparable to existing benchmark entries without re-scoring.
paragraphs.zh: 保留本基准测试中使用的两个报告界面之间的严格区分。 绝对的按配置中位数是针对其自身的稠密基线来描述一个配置的，绝不能沿列纵向跨不同配置进行比较。 成对差值不携带绝对水平，是用于对加速方法进行排名的唯一界面。 同时维护这两个界面无需额外的评分工作，因为配对是在生成表格时通过简单的连接与相减完成的，从而确保新方法无需重新评分即可立即与现有的基准测试条目进行比较。

paragraphs.en: RoboWorM serves as a critical filter for identifying high-fidelity video world models that can be reliably deployed across diverse downstream robotic pipelines. High-ranking models can function as robust interactive simulators, e.g., Ctrl-World ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , to (i) support non-Markovian task execution , providing the temporal consistency required for object-centric memory states, semantic-graph planning ( Vo et al., 2026 ; Hanyu et al., 2026 ; Chung et al., 2026 ) . Additionally, these models facilitate robust policy adaptation by (ii) synthesizing novel, high-quality rollout videos from sparse demonstrations and text prompts to support few-shot frameworks ( Nguyen et al., 2026a ; Ha et al., 2026 ) . For post-training phases, top-tier models provide the envisioned trajectories needed to align generative control policies through progress-guided preference generation ( Luu et al., 2026 ) and rolling imagination frameworks ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: RoboWorM 可作为一个关键筛选器，用于识别那些能够可靠部署于多样化下游机器人流水线的高保真视频世界模型。 排名靠前的模型可以作为稳健的交互式模拟器，例如 Ctrl-World（Guo et al., 2026），以（i）支持非马尔可夫任务执行，为以对象为中心的记忆状态和语义图规划（Vo et al., 2026；Hanyu et al., 2026；Chung et al., 2026）提供所需的时间一致性。 此外，这些模型还可以通过（ii）从稀疏演示和文本提示合成新颖、高质量的轨迹回放视频来支持少样本框架（Nguyen et al., 2026a；Ha et al., 2026），从而促进稳健的策略适配。 在后训练阶段，顶级模型可以提供通过进度引导的偏好生成（Luu et al., 2026）和滚动想象框架（Zhou et al., 2026）来对齐生成式控制策略所需的设想轨迹。

sents.en: RoboWorM serves as a critical filter for identifying high-fidelity video world models that can be reliably deployed across diverse downstream robotic pipelines.

sents.en: High-ranking models can function as robust interactive simulators, e.g., Ctrl-World ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , to (i) support non-Markovian task execution , providing the temporal consistency required for object-centric memory states, semantic-graph planning ( Vo et al., 2026 ; Hanyu et al., 2026 ; Chung et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: When extended to multi-view generation, these ranked models can (iii) synthesize 3D demonstrations to train spatial policies like PointWorld ( Huang et al., 2026 ) ; however, managing this high-dimensional data requires strict architectural optimization, such as minimizing necessary point cloud tokens ( Tran Anh et al., 2026 ) , restricting fine-tuning to essential layers ( Nguyen et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , or speed-up techniques ( Tran et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Nguyen et al., 2026c ) to maintain viable inference speeds. Finally, deploying these filtered models in ( iv) highly cluttered environments ( Nguyen et al., 2026e ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Vo et al., 2025 ) necessitates coupling the generated visuals with explicit geometric grounding and automated scene generation (e.g., SimFoundry ( Ranawaka et al., 2026 ) ) to ensure object-centric spatial reasoning remains accurate under occlusion.
paragraphs.zh: 当扩展到多视角生成时，这些经过排序的模型可以（iii）合成 3D 演示来训练 PointWorld 等空间策略（Huang et al., 2026）；然而，管理这种高维数据需要严格的架构优化，例如最小化必要的点云 token（Tran Anh et al., 2026）、将微调限制在关键层（Nguyen et al., 2026b; Liu et al., 2025），或使用加速技术（Tran et al., 2024; Zhao et al., 2026; Nguyen et al., 2026c）以保持可行的推理速度。 最后，将这些经过筛选的模型部署在（iv）高度杂乱的环境中（Nguyen et al., 2026e; Liu et al., 2026; Vo et al., 2025），需要将生成的视觉内容与显式的几何接地和自动化场景生成（例如 SimFoundry（Ranawaka et al., 2026））相结合，以确保以物体为中心的空间推理在遮挡情况下仍然保持准确。
